data.title: Senior Principal Agentic Engineer
data.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50, 000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work-but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. 

About Lilly

At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50, 000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly. 

About Tech@Lilly

At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Hyderabad builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve. 

About The Technology Organization

Technology at Lilly builds and operates mission-critical digital products and platforms that support the discovery, development, and delivery of medicines that make life better for people around the world. Our teams operate in highly regulated, high-availability environments, where operational excellence, reliability, and quality are non-negotiable. 

Within Tech@Lilly, the Digital Core organization applies a product, platform, and reliability-first mindset, ensuring that operational capabilities scale sustainably across the enterprise. 

About The Team

Tech@Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using pioneering technologies like the most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Lilly IT is that we redefine what's possible through tech to advance our purpose, creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, including data-driven drug discovery, connected clinical trials, resilient enterprise platforms, and intelligent digital operations. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver creative solutions in every area of our business. 

The Digital Core team leads Lilly's transformation into the Digital and AI era. They inspire digitally empowered teams to new ways of working and accelerate innovation and agility. This team powers and advances the entire company by building and maintaining world-class technology capabilities and platforms. 

Lilly Capability Centre India (LCCI), Hyderabad, is Lilly's premier Global Technology Hub, harnessing data, AI, analytics, and digital solutions to revolutionize healthcare and improve patient outcomes worldwide. 

Role summary

You own the agentic resolution platform end to end - both the cloud-native substrate it runs on and the intelligent agents that run on top of it. From Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability through agent runtime, LLM patterns, retrieval, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop boundaries, you write the production code, design the architecture, and set the engineering bar that lets automation deflect routine operational work before it ever reaches a human. 

This is a senior individual-contributor role that is both strategic and deeply hands-on. You ship production platform services and agentic capabilities, make the build-vs-buy calls on tooling and model access, and partner with the senior architect on the patterns that scale. Success is measured by rising deflection, sustained toil reduction, platform availability and developer velocity, and the ability to scale agentic intelligence through systems and people - not individual effort. 

What you'll be doing

- Agentic resolution platform - intake to action
 - Architect the agentic resolution platform end to end: intake, classification, action execution, verification, and human-in-the-loop fallback. 
 - Build the agent runtime and orchestration layer: agent state and memory, tool integration, multi-agent coordination patterns, and confidence-thresholded handoffs to humans. 
 - Define agent-decision observability, audit-ready posture, and the data contracts that let the platform consume durable fixes from upstream engineering teams. 
 - LLM application patterns, knowledge, and evaluation rigor
 - Design production LLM patterns: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured outputs, multi-model routing, and hybrid retrieval over the knowledge corpus. 
 - Own the knowledge-base strategy as a compounding deflection lever - every resolved incident becomes training data and structured retrieval input for future automation. 
 - Establish evaluation and guardrail frameworks for non-deterministic systems: automated evals, quality scoring, drift detection, and feedback loops that compound agent quality over time. 
 - Cloud-native platform - build and operate
 - Architect and operate Kubernetes (EKS or equivalent) at scale for container and serverless workloads supporting agentic and LLM inference traffic patterns. 
 - Write production platform services and internal tooling (Python or Go) that automate provisioning, deployment, and operational workflows - not just infrastructure configuration. 
 - Define and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform) integrated with a major cloud's AI stack (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, or Vertex AI), with secrets management and audit-ready posture for regulated environments. 
 - CI/CD, observability, and developer experience
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines tuned for agentic and AI workloads: model and agent versioning, canary rollouts, evaluation gates, and rollback. 
 - Own the observability stack (Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry plus enterprise tooling) and instrument platform health, agent-decision telemetry, and model-inference metrics. 
 - Establish SLOs, SLIs, and reliability standards for both platform and agentic system health; design self-service patterns and golden-path templates that accelerate delivery. 
 - Cross-team partnership, security, and talent development
 - Partner with the Reliability Engineering team on which production patterns become agent-assisted automations, and with senior architects on the patterns that scale. 
 - Own security posture: network policies, pod security, secrets rotation, vulnerability scanning, and access controls in a regulated pharmaceutical environment. 
 - Set the engineering bar through code quality standards, architectural reviews, and role modeling; mentor senior engineers in agentic AI, LLM application patterns, and platform engineering. Influence engineering leaders to adopt automation-friendly patterns at the source, not just downstream. 

How you will succeed

- Be recognized as the senior technical authority for agentic platform engineering in your area. 
 - Demonstrate measurable, sustained improvements: rising deflection rates, reduced toil, fewer recurring incidents, faster resolution, platform uptime, and deployment velocity. 
 - Ship production platform services and agentic capabilities that tangibly move the deflection and developer-experience numbers. 
 - Scale agentic intelligence through systems, standards, and people - not individual heroics. 

What you should bring

Required

- 12+ years of progressive technology experience with substantial hands-on architecture and delivery of automation, AIOps, agentic systems, or cloud-native platforms at enterprise scale. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of measurable deflection or operational-toil-reduction outcomes in a production environment - with the numbers to show it. 
 - Deep technical fluency in agentic system design: agent runtimes, multi-agent orchestration, tool integration, memory and state management. Practical experience with at least one major framework (LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or MCP). 
 - Production experience with LLM application patterns: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured outputs, and multi-model routing. 
 - Deep cloud-native background: Kubernetes (EKS or equivalent) at scale, container workloads, infrastructure as code (Terraform), and at least one major cloud's AI stack (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, or Vertex AI). 
 - Proven ability to build and ship production platform services and tooling - not just configure infrastructure. Expert-level Python (async, packaging, performance) for production services; Go also welcome. 
 - Strong CI/CD engineering experience for AI and agentic workloads: model and agent deployment, versioning, canary/blue-green strategies, evaluation gates, and rollback. 
 - Observability for AI systems: metrics, logs, traces, and agent-decision telemetry using Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry, plus at least one enterprise stack (Splunk, Datadog, or Dynatrace). 
 - Demonstrated rigor in evaluation and guardrails for non-deterministic systems - automated evals, drift detection, human-in-the-loop verification, and feedback loops. 
 - Strong security engineering foundation: network policies, secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and access controls in regulated environments. 
 - Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field. 
 - Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to translate technical strategy for senior business and technology leadership. 

This is a hybrid role spanning agentic AI, LLM patterns, cloud-native platform, and developer tooling. We expect strong depth in 2-3 of these areas with the breadth and judgment to learn adjacent domains. Not every tool listed is required. 

Preferred

- Working knowledge of operational ML: anomaly detection, event correlation, alert-noise reduction, and model/agent monitoring in production. 
 - Experience with AI observability tooling (e. g. , LangSmith, Weights & Biases, custom telemetry pipelines).

Daxko builds the software that powers fitness, wellness, and community organizations-everything from member management and payments to digital engagement and analytics.  - Strong experience testing payment gateways and complex financial workflows like billing, refunds, and subscription logic
 - Experience using AI coding assistants to generate and maintain automated scripts, with the QA discipline to validate accuracy and eliminate flakiness
 - Solid understanding of testing RESTful APIs and asynchronous messaging systems

Nice To Have

- Experience with mobile test automation frameworks for Flutter apps

Location: Financial District, Hyderabad, Telangana

Job Summary

We are looking for an Avionics Hardware Lead to own the onboard electronics of our spacecraft, from system specification to tested flight hardware. The role covers defining avionics requirements from mission goals and designing microcontroller-based circuits, power electronics and subsystem interfaces. The Lead will drive circuit simulation, PCB layout, component selection and testing, and ensure every board meets space-grade quality and reliability standards. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. The Lead will head a team of engineers, set design and documentation standards, and work closely with the GNC, AIT and QA teams to deliver reliable hardware on schedule. 

Key Responsibilities

•  Translate mission and system goals into clear avionics system specifications. 

•  Lead design and development of electronic circuits built around microcontrollers. 

•  Run circuit simulations and review PCB layouts before fabrication. 

•  Select, design and test low-power DC-DC converters and power distribution circuits. 

•  Define and implement interfaces between avionics units over serial and parallel buses, with signal conditioning using op-amps and current-to-voltage converters. 

•  Select components suitable for space applications, including qualified use of industrial-grade parts. 

•  Apply QA practices in line with MIL-STD-883, ISO and AS9100 requirements. 

•  Prepare and maintain design documents, test procedures and reports. 

•  Lead, mentor and review the work of a team of avionics engineers. 

Qualifications

Work Experience: 8 to 10 years

Required Skill Set (Major)

•        Experience in design and development of electronic circuits with microcontrollers.

•        Good knowledge of circuit simulation in KiCad, PSpice or similar tools. 

•        Knowledge of PCB layout. 

•        Knowledge of power electronics such as low-power DC-DC converters, including selection and testing.

•        Experience in leading a team of engineers. 

•        Good documentation aptitude.

1.       General knowledge of space systems for satellite building. 

2.       Firmware knowledge

Required Soft Skills

•          Ability to lead, guide and motivate a team of engineers. 

•          Strong sense of ownership from design through to testing. 

•          Clear communication with engineers, management and vendors. 

•          Works well with GNC, mechanical, AIT and QA teams.

data.title: Senior Engineer I, Software Development - Insight
data.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to lead the development of our cloud-based Network Management System (NMS) platform. This role involves building sophisticated web applications and mobile interfaces that enable enterprise customers to monitor, configure, and manage their network infrastructure including switches, routers, and WiFi access points at scale. 

Key Responsibilities

- NMS Platform Development: Design and develop scalable web applications for network device management, monitoring, and configuration
 - Real-time Dashboard Creation: Build responsive dashboards displaying network topology, device status, performance metrics, and alerting systems
 - Device Integration: Develop APIs and interfaces for managing diverse network hardware (switches, routers, access points) from multiple vendors
 - Network Visualization: Create interactive network topology maps and device relationship diagrams
 - Mobile Management Apps: Build mobile applications for field technicians to configure and troubleshoot network devices remotely
 - Performance Monitoring: Implement real-time network performance monitoring, SNMP integration, and telemetry data visualization
 - Configuration Management: Develop tools for bulk device configuration, firmware updates, and policy deployment
 - Alert Systems: Build intelligent alerting and notification systems for network events and anomalies
 - Multi-tenant Architecture: Contribute to secure, scalable multi-tenant SaaS platform architecture
 - API Development: Create RESTful APIs for third-party integrations and customer automation workflows

Technical Requirements

- Frontend: Advanced proficiency in React. js, MUI/Material UI, Javascript TypeScript, D3. js for network visualizations, WebSocket for real-time updates
 - Backend: Strong experience with Node. js, Python, or Java for building scalable network management services
 - Network Protocols: Understanding of SNMP, SSH, Telnet, NETCONF, REST APIs for network device communication
 - Database Systems: Experience with time-series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB) for network metrics and traditional databases
 - Cloud Platforms: AWS/Azure/GCP experience with focus on networking services, load balancers, and auto-scaling
 - Monitoring Tools: Experience with network monitoring protocols, log aggregation, and observability platforms
 - Security: Knowledge of network security principles, VPN configurations, and secure device access methods
 - DevOps: CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation

Domain-Specific Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or related technical field
 - 10-12 years of full-stack development experience with 3+ years in network management or infrastructure software
 - Strong understanding of TCP/IP, OSI model, routing protocols, and enterprise networking concepts
 - Experience with network device APIs (Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, Ubiquiti, etc. )
 - Knowledge of WiFi standards (802. 11), network switching concepts, and routing protocols
 - Experience building SaaS platforms for enterprise customers
 - Familiarity with network automation tools (Ansible, Puppet) and Infrastructure as Code

data.description:
Job Description Summary

Managers of people from multiple families within the function. Impacts the team's ability to achieve service, quality and timeliness of objectives. The role is subject to operating policy objectives. There is moderate autonomy within the role. High levels of operational judgment are required to achieve outcomes required. 

Join a global engineering team utilizing advanced design tools and techniques to develop state-of-the-art Computed Tomography systems. Systems engineering is a cross-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the user's needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation.

Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

data.title: Design Manager – Mechanical (Water & Wastewater Infrastructure)
data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

As a Design Manager - Mechanical Infrastructure, you will lead the multidisciplinary mechanical design delivery for complex water and wastewater infrastructure projects, including pump stations, water treatment plants (WTPs), wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs), desalination systems, and associated mechanical/process systems. 

You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, quality assurance, constructability, risk management, and programme certainty across all stages of project delivery-from concept through detailed and construction design. 

Working closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional Leadership, you will plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of mechanical design packages, while mentoring and developing engineers across global teams. 

Key duties include

- Lead and manage mechanical design for water/wastewater pump stations, treatment plants, and associated mechanical/process systems. 
 - Develop project-specific mechanical design strategies ensuring multidisciplinary integration, alignment with project requirements, and risk mitigation. 
 - Oversee preparation and coordination of mechanical deliverables
 - Equipment sizing & selection
 - Mechanical design calculations
 - Pumping system calculations & hydraulic checks
 - P&IDs, equipment layouts, plant general arrangements
 - Mechanical data sheets and specifications
 - Review and validate vendor documents, datasheets, and shop drawings; ensure integration with overall design. 
 - Lead mechanical engineering inputs for Design for Design‐Build (D for DB) and EPC delivery models constructability, staging, installation methodology, O&M requirements. 
 - Support and lead HAZOP/HAZID, value engineering, risk workshops, failure mode assessments, and operability/maintainability reviews. 
 - Manage and own key design management documents
 - Project Responsibility Matrix
 - Basis of Design
 - Overall Design Programme
 - Schedule of Deliverables
 - Design Risk Register
 - Design Change Register
 - Coordinate with process, civil, electrical, ICA, BIM, structural, and architectural teams for holistic design delivery. 
 - Engage with clients through workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical clarifications. 
 - Ensure design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, project specifications, and HSE requirements. 
 - Support the preparation of technical proposals, LOE estimates, design execution plans, and project scheduling. 
 - Mentor, coach, and provide performance feedback to engineers to strengthen organisational capability. 
 - Collaborate with global delivery centres to ensure consistent design practices and effective resource utilisation. 

We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects. 

Here's what you'll need

Key software tools

- PipeFlo, AFT Fathom/Impulse, WaterGEMS (for hydraulics interface), vendor pump selection software
 - Planning & Coordination Primavera P6, MS Project
 - Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
 - BIM (exposure advantageous) Revit, Plant 3D, OpenPlant Modeler, Navisworks, Revizto

Key Behaviours

- Builds strong, collaborative relationships across multidisciplinary teams. 
 - Confident, approachable leader with strong client‐facing presence. 
 - Demonstrates leadership through coordination, clarity, and proactive communication. 
 - Encourages teams to develop integrated, constructible, and high‐quality mechanical design solutions. 
 - Organised, disciplined, and able to resolve complex mechanical issues in a timely manner. 
 - Champions a strong culture of safety, quality, and innovation. 
 - Flexible, dependable, and capable of performing in fast‐paced, contractor‐integrated environments. 

Work Experience

- 15+ years of experience in mechanical engineering design and design management within water/wastewater infrastructure projects. 
 - Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams delivering mechanical design for
 - Water/wastewater pump stations
 - WTPs/WWTPs and associated process units
 - Chemical dosing systems
 - Sludge handling systems

data.title: Solar Digital Monitoring & IoT Systems - Roofsol Energy
data.description:
Job Description - Solar Digital Monitoring & IoT Systems

Company: Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd. 

Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra

Department: Technology / Digital Solutions

Experience: Approximately 10 years

Employment Type: Full-time

About Roofsol Energy

Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd. operates in the solar energy sector, developing and managing solar projects across India. The company has invested in multiple solar projects under the OPEX (CAPEX-free / RESCO) business model, where continuous monitoring of generation, plant performance, equipment health, and operational efficiency is essential. 

As part of its technology development strategy, Roofsol Energy intends to establish its own end-to-end solar monitoring ecosystem, including proprietary data loggers, IoT-based data acquisition systems, cloud infrastructure, and a centralized solar generation monitoring platform. The objective is to develop and own the underlying technology and Intellectual Property (IP), while ensuring reliable monitoring and management of a large portfolio of distributed solar projects across India. 

  

Role Overview

Roofsol Energy is looking for an experienced technology professional to lead the conceptualization, design, development, deployment, and maintenance of an in-house solar data logging and generation monitoring system. 

  

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Strategy and Technology Development

·            Define the technology roadmap for Roofsol Energy's proprietary solar monitoring and data acquisition ecosystem. 

·            Lead the end-to-end development of the monitoring platform, from product architecture and prototype development to commercial deployment. 

·            Evaluate appropriate hardware, communication protocols, software frameworks, cloud technologies, and system architectures. 

·            Develop solutions suitable for both small rooftop solar installations and large distributed solar portfolios. 

2. Data Logger and IoT Hardware Development

·            Lead the design, development, prototyping, testing, and deployment of in-house solar data logging equipment. 

·            Develop expertise in integrating inverters, energy meters, weather sensors, and other plant equipment using protocols such as Modbus RTU/TCP, RS485, Ethernet, and MQTT, as applicable. 

·            Ensure reliable data acquisition, local buffering, time synchronization, remote configuration, and recovery during network or power outages. 

·            Establish hardware validation, field testing, quality assurance, and lifecycle management processes. 

3. Cloud Platform and Software Development

·            Lead the architecture and development of a centralized cloud-based solar monitoring platform. 

·            Establish scalable infrastructure for collecting, processing, storing, and analyzing data from hundreds of geographically distributed solar installations. 

·            Oversee the development of dashboards, plant-level monitoring screens, portfolio-level reporting, alerts, notifications, and automated performance reports. 

·            Ensure integration with existing business systems, maintenance workflows, and third-party equipment where required. 

·            Establish high availability, disaster recovery, backup, cybersecurity, and system performance standards. 

  

4. Solar Generation Monitoring and Analytics

·            Develop real-time and historical solar generation monitoring capabilities. 

·            Establish monitoring of energy generation, plant availability, equipment health, communication failures, and performance deviations. 

·            Enable automated alerts for generation losses, inverter faults, abnormal operating conditions, and data gaps. 

·            Support performance analysis through relevant metrics such as specific yield, Performance Ratio (PR), plant availability, and actual-versus-expected generation, where applicable. 

  

5. Intellectual Property and Technology Ownership

·            Build and maintain Roofsol Energy's proprietary technology stack, including hardware designs, firmware, software source code, system architecture, technical documentation, and associated IP. 

·            Establish appropriate IP ownership, confidentiality, source-code control, licensing, and third-party technology compliance practices. 

  

6. Team Leadership and Vendor Management

·            Build and lead a multidisciplinary team covering embedded systems, electronics, firmware, IoT, cloud engineering, software development, and data analytics. 

·            Evaluate and manage technology vendors, hardware manufacturers, system integrators, and development partners. 

  

Candidate Profile

·            Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics & Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, IoT, or a related technical discipline. 

·            Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, industrial data acquisition, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, or related technology domains. 

·            Demonstrated experience in developing and deploying connected hardware and software products, preferably from concept through production and field deployment. 

·            Experience with cloud infrastructure, databases, APIs, cybersecurity, remote device management, and scalable system architecture. 

·            Knowledge of solar PV systems, inverter communications, energy meters, generation monitoring, and renewable energy analytics will be highly advantageous. 

  

  

Why Join Roofsol Energy?

  This is an opportunity to establish a proprietary technology platform from the ground up and take ownership of a strategic digital initiative within the renewable energy sector. The selected professional will have the opportunity to shape the company's technology roadmap, develop in-house IP, and build a scalable monitoring ecosystem supporting a growing portfolio of solar assets across India. 

Interested candidates may share their updated CV highlighting relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, and technology ownership.

 - Problem Solving & Analysis: Utilize in-depth specialty knowledge of applications development to analyze complex technical issues, evaluate business and system processes against industry standards, and exercise sound evaluative judgment. 
 - Security & Compliance: Recommend and integrate robust security measures during and after post-implementation reviews to ensure system integrity, safety, and functionality. 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Consult with clients, business users, and cross-functional technology teams to resolve issues, recommend advanced programming solutions, and support client-facing systems. 
 - Standards & Governance: Ensure essential development and operating procedures are adhered to, contributing to the definition of engineering standards and best practices.

 - Autonomous Execution: Operate effectively with minimal direct supervision while exercising independent judgment and ownership. 
 - Subject Matter Expertise: Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for senior stakeholders and engineering team members.

Qualifications

- Experience: 8+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of designing and building scalable, robust backend systems.

 - Frontend Technologies: Practical exposure to modern frontend frameworks (e. g. , React or Angular) is highly preferred.

 - DevOps & Tooling: Hands-on experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development tooling. 
 - Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to perform under pressure in fast-paced environments.

data.description:
About 4flow

4flow is a global leader in logistics optimization, with a team of over 1, 500 professionals across more than 20 locations worldwide. Our unique business model integrates supply chain consulting, advanced logistics software, 4PL services, and cutting-edge logistics research to deliver innovative and end-to-end solutions. 

Our Bangalore office, located in Manyata Tech Park, is one of our newest and most dynamic hubs. Here, we are building a next-generation, AI-driven supply chain product from the ground up. Operating in a hybrid work model, this location offers a unique opportunity to join the development team at an early stage and play a key role in shaping the future of our product and technology landscape. 

Job Description

Designs, develops, and operates end-to-end software solutions across frontend and backend systems, combining deep technical expertise with a broad cross-functional understanding of product, platform, and operations. Acts as a T-shaped engineer, bringing strong specialization while contributing effectively across adjacent domains such as DevOps, security, performance, and user experience to maximize product value. This role requires close collaboration with globally distributed teams across regions and time zones to ensure alignment, consistency, and successful delivery of shared product goals. 

What your new challenge will look like

- Design and develop front-end and back-end components within service-based architecture, ensuring scalability, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Own the end-to-end software lifecycle, from ideation and system design to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 
 - Apply T-shaped engineering principles, contributing beyond core specialization to areas such as product understanding, UX impact, reliability, and security. 
 - Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies to enhance architecture, developer productivity, and product capabilities. 
 - Drive automation across system setup, CI/CD pipelines, deployments, and operational processes in collaboration with DevOps practices. 
 - Identify system bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural gaps; lead initiatives for continuous improvement. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, UX/UI, QA, DevOps, and Security to deliver high-quality, customer-centric solutions. 
 - Engage in technical discussions with global stakeholders, contributing to architecture decisions, standards, and best practices. 
 - Make informed technical decisions by evaluating trade-offs across engineering, product, and operational dimensions. 
 - Promote engineering excellence by establishing reusable patterns, frameworks, and tooling. 
 - Conduct code reviews, mentor engineers, and foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous learning. 

Why you belong at 4flow

- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or related field
 - 8+ years of experience in modern web applications and distributed systems
 - Strong expertise in both frontend and backend (T‐shaped profile)
 - Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React, Next. js, PrimeVue. js
 - Backend: Java 17+, Spring Boot
 - Strong knowledge of modular architecture, API design, microservices
 - Familiarity with Domain‐Driven Design (DDD) is a plus
 - Ability to evaluate trade‐offs and deliver scalable solutions
 - Working knowledge of AWS, CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies
 - Experience with monitoring, logging, observability
 - Understanding of security fundamentals (authentication, authorization, secure coding)
 - Ability to connect technical decisions with business outcomes
 - Contributions to performance optimization, DevOps, security, test automation, platform architecture
 - Tools: Git, Gradle, Maven, GitLab CI/CD, Jira, Confluence
 - Nice to have: SQL/NoSQL databases, Docker, Linux environments, AI/ML integrations
 - ERP systems experience (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics)
 - Knowledge of inventory, supply chain, order management workflows
 - Experience with ERP APIs, data synchronization, interoperability
 - Passion for software engineering and curiosity beyond specialization
 - T‐shaped mindset with openness to learn across domains
 - Strong analytical and systems‐thinking abilities
 - Pragmatic decision‐making with technical depth
 - Self‐driven, adaptable, thrives in fast‐paced environments
 - Excellent communication and collaboration in global teams
 - Builds strong cross‐cultural relationships
 - Commitment to continuous learning, innovation, and engineering excellence
 - Motivated to align with company values and contribute to success

What we offer

- A stable role within a company rooted in strong German roots, backed by a clear vision and long-term security. 
 - A dynamic, international work environment with excellent opportunities for rapid career growth. 
 - Extensive professional development support, including a dedicated training budget and access to internal learning programs. 
 - A permanent position with a competitive base salary, attractive bonus structure, and comprehensive benefits package. 
 - Hybrid work model
 - Access to an Employee Assistance Program to support your mental well-being. 
 - Regular sports activities, team events, and company getaways that foster connection and collaboration. 
 - Complimentary lunch, beverages, and coffee at all 4flow locations. 
 - Comprehensive health insurance coverage, including GMC, GPA, GTL, and OPD.

data.title: Design Verification - Technical Leader
data.description:
OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50, 000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. 

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. 

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Digital Verification Engineer to take on a Technical Leader role within our Imaging verification team. The candidate will drive verification strategy and closure for complex digital IPs in imaging and automotive subsystems, mentor junior engineers, and act as the technical point of contact for verification across cross-functional teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end verification strategy, planning, and closure for one or more complex IPs/subsystems. 
 - Architect and review UVM-based verification environments, ensuring reusability and scalability across projects. 
 - Drive functional and code coverage closure; define coverage models and identify verification gaps early in the cycle. 
 - Lead protocol-level verification efforts (e. g. , I3C, MIPI, AMBA), including VIP evaluation, integration, and debug. 
 - Apply the use of formal verification techniques (e. g. , JasperGold) to complement simulation-based verification, particularly for FSM and control-logic-heavy blocks. 
 - Review test plans, testbenches, and verification collateral authored by team members; provide technical guidance on methodology and debug approaches. 
 - Interface with design, architecture, DFT, and software teams to clarify specification ambiguities and drive design-for-verification practices. 
 - Identify and resolve spec ambiguities/errata; work with IP/protocol working groups where applicable. 
 - Mentor and technically guide junior verification engineers; support their ramp-up on tools, methodology, and protocols. 
 - Drive process improvements: regression infrastructure, debug efficiency, coverage methodology, and verification reuse. 
 - Communicate verification status, risks, and closure plans to management and stakeholders. 
 - Support root-cause analysis of silicon/post-silicon issues traced back to verification gaps, where relevant. 

Required Skills

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering (VLSI specialization preferred). 
 - 5-7 years of experience in digital design/IP verification, with demonstrated ownership of verification closure for at least one complex IP or subsystem. 
 - Strong expertise in System Verilog and UVM methodology - testbench architecture, sequences, scoreboards, and reference models. 
 - Proven experience with functional coverage, code coverage, and assertion-based verification (SVA); ability to define coverage models from specification. 
 - Hands-on experience with industry-standard simulation tools (VCS, Xcelium, or Questa) and debug tools. 
 - Experience with formal verification tools and methodology (e. g. , JasperGold) for FSM, connectivity, or control-logic verification. 
 - Solid understanding of one or more protocols such as I3C, I2C, SPI, AMBA, MIPI-CSI, or similar interconnect/interface standards, including VIP-based verification. 
 - Strong scripting skills (Python, Perl, or TCL) for automation, flow development, and regression management. 
 - Ability to read and interpret design specifications, RTL, and identify verification risk areas independently. 

Preferred / Good To Have

- Experience mentoring or technically leading a small team of verification engineers. 
 - Exposure to mutation testing or other coverage-quality assessment techniques. 
 - Familiarity with low-power verification (UPF/CPF) and Gate Level simulations. 
 - Experience working with EDA vendors (e. g. , Cadence, Synopsys) for tool/methodology support and issue resolution. 
 - Prior contribution to internal verification methodology documents, guidelines, or reusable verification IP (VIP) development. 
 - Experience working in a globally distributed team environment. 

Soft Skills

- Strong technical leadership and mentoring ability. 
 - Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous or under-specified requirements. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills - able to present technical status and risk clearly to management. 
 - Ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and drive closure under deadlines. 
 - Collaborative approach to working with design, architecture, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML assisted verification techniques to improve verification productivity and efficiency. 

What We Offer

- A technical leadership track with visibility into IP-level and subsystem-level verification strategy. 
 - Opportunity to shape verification methodology, including formal and protocol verification practices. 
 - Mentorship and people-development opportunities within a growing team. 
 - Exposure to advanced verification domains including formal verification and next-generation Security IP and systems. 
 - Collaborative, cross-functional work environment with global teams. 

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance. 

At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture. 

To discover more, visit st. com/careers.

data.title: Senior Manager, Applied Science

About Tekion

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3, 000 people across North America, Asia and Europe. 

Summary

Responsible for leading advanced applied science initiatives that drive innovation, optimize business outcomes, and expand the capabilities of data-driven products and services. This role requires strategic oversight, technical excellence, and the ability to translate scientific advancements into real-world applications. It involves cross-functional collaboration, mentoring, and execution of complex machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions. 

Duties & Responsibilities

- Lead a team of applied scientists and machine learning engineers in developing and deploying advanced models and algorithms. 
 - Drive the technical vision, research agenda, and roadmap for applied science initiatives aligned with business priorities. 
 - Oversee experimentation, evaluation, and deployment of machine learning models into production environments. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to integrate models into scalable systems. 
 - Champion best practices in scientific rigor, experimentation, reproducibility, and responsible AI. 
 - Mentor team members and foster a high-performance culture grounded in innovation and continuous learning. 
 - Monitor project progress, remove blockers, and ensure delivery of high-impact outcomes on time and within scope.

data.title: ASIC Digital Design, Sr Manager
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent the better part of your career building and verifying silicon that actually ships, not just passes simulation. You know that verification is where the real complexity lives, where assumptions break, and where a good engineer becomes a great one by catching the corner case no one thought to write down. Leading a team is not about delegation for you, it is about building engineers who think critically, ask the right questions, and take ownership of the hard problems. 

You have been in the room when a design looked perfect on paper but fell apart under real stimulus. That experience taught you to build verification environments that stress the design in ways the architect did not anticipate. Mentorship matters to you because you remember the engineers who shaped how you think, and you want to do that for others. 

Managing multiple projects does not overwhelm you because you have learned to prioritize what matters, push back when timelines do not match reality, and keep your team focused on the work that moves the needle. You are technical enough to review a testbench architecture and organizational enough to keep three projects on track without losing sight of the people doing the work. 

At Synopsys, you will lead verification for complex ASIC designs that power the products our customers build, and you will do it with a team that values depth, rigor, and getting it right. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead a team of design and verification engineers in Noida, managing performance, growth, and day-to-day execution across multiple ASIC projects
 - Own the verification strategy and environment architecture for complex, high-speed protocol designs, defining testplans and coverage models that catch real issues
 - Drive technical decisions around verification flows, including SystemVerilog, UVM, behavioral modeling, and coverage-driven verification
 - Work directly with architects, RTL designers, and VIP teams to align on design intent, resolve ambiguities, and ensure functional correctness before tapeout
 - Identify design gaps and propose corrective actions when documented functionality does not match implementation or customer requirements
 - Reproduce and resolve customer-reported issues through deep technical analysis, working backward from symptoms to root cause
 - Continuously improve verification methodologies, tooling, and execution efficiency across the team

The Impact You Will Have

- Deliver functionally correct, high-performance silicon designs that ship to customers and power next-generation products
 - Build a team culture where engineers grow technically, take ownership, and solve hard problems without waiting for perfect direction
 - Reduce time-to-market by catching design issues early through rigorous verification and well-architected testbenches
 - Strengthen cross-functional collaboration between design, architecture, and verification, ensuring alignment and reducing late-stage surprises
 - Influence verification best practices across Synopsys, shaping how teams approach coverage, automation, and testbench design
 - Resolve customer issues faster and more thoroughly, building trust and long-term partnerships
 - Set the technical bar for what great verification looks like, raising the standard across projects and teams

What You'll Need

- 15+ years of hands-on experience in ASIC design and verification, with deep expertise in high-speed protocols and complex digital systems
 - Strong proficiency in Verilog, VHDL, and SystemVerilog for RTL design and verification
 - Proven experience building UVM-based verification environments, including testbench architecture, coverage analysis, and constraint-driven stimulus
 - Solid scripting skills in BASH, TCSH, PERL, PYTHON, or TCL for automation, flow development, and productivity tooling
 - Track record of managing and mentoring engineering teams, balancing technical leadership with people development
 - Experience working through ambiguous requirements, incomplete specs, or shifting priorities without losing momentum

Who You Are

- You can review a verification plan and immediately spot what is missing, whether it is a corner case, a coverage gap, or an unrealistic timeline
 - You give feedback that makes engineers better, not just feedback that checks a box during a review cycle
 - You are comfortable saying no when a project plan does not match reality, and you can explain why in a way that moves the conversation forward
 - You manage multiple projects without losing track of the details that matter, knowing when to dive deep and when to trust your team
 - You write and communicate clearly in English, whether it is a technical document, a status update, or a difficult conversation with a stakeholder
 - You adapt quickly when priorities shift, helping your team stay focused on what matters most without creating chaos

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Technical Lead
data.description:
Job Summary - AI Technical Lead. 

- Kumaran Systems is looking for an experienced AI Lead (Technical) to lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable, production-ready AI/ML solutions within its Equity Market Technology -Capital Markets domain. 

- The role will drive innovation in Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI workflows, and intelligent automation using the Microsoft Azure cloud platform. 

- The candidate will provide technical leadership to a team of AI engineers, collaborate closely with stakeholders, data scientists, and platform teams, and translate business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable AI solutions. 

- The role requires strong hands-on technical expertise, solution architecture capabilities, and the ability to lead AI initiatives from Concept to Production. 

Details of Employment: 

Location: Chennai, India

Work Location - Guindy Olympia Tech Park OR SIPCOT Siruseri. 

Mode of Employment - 3 days Hybrid in the Office. 

Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent. 

Notice Period - 0 to 15 days from the date of the offer (Critical Requisition; hence the ask)

Key Responsibilities

1. AI Architecture and Solution Design

- Architect and lead the development of enterprise-grade RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, vector databases, embedding models, and retrieval strategies using Azure AI Search, FAISS, and Pinecone. 
 - Design and implement Agentic AI systems incorporating autonomous agents, multi-step planning, tool orchestration, reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Develop AI solutions that integrate with internal systems, including trading platforms, operations workbenches, and risk engines, to automate decision support, exception handling, and reporting. 
 - Establish standards for prompt engineering, AI guardrails, and evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, A/B testing, and automated regression testing. 

2. Azure Cloud and AI Platform Engineering

- Lead the design, implementation, and management of AI/ML infrastructure on Microsoft Azure using Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). 
 - Design scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient AI inference pipelines using caching, request batching, and token-budget optimization. 
 - Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML models and AI agents, incorporating model versioning, controlled deployments, A/B testing, rollback mechanisms, and observability. 
 - Ensure compliance with enterprise cloud governance, data residency, and security requirements using Azure Private Endpoints, Managed Identity, Key Vault, and related security controls. 

3. AI Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting

- Diagnose and resolve production AI performance issues, including inference latency, embedding drift, retrieval quality degradation, hallucinations, and context-window limitations. 
 - Monitor and optimize token consumption, API rate limits, throughput, and cost per query across production AI workloads. 
 - Establish AI observability through structured logging, distributed tracing across prompt processing, retrieval, and generation, and dashboards tracking latency (p50/p95/p99), retrieval recall, and answer relevance. 
 - Conduct root-cause analysis of AI system failures, including incorrect tool invocations, RAG retrieval failures, safety-filter false positives, and model regressions following version upgrades. 

4. Technical Leadership and Collaboration

- Lead and mentor a team of 4-6 AI/ML engineers, overseeing code reviews, architecture decisions, sprint planning, engineering standards, and professional development. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, quantitative teams, and operations leaders to translate business requirements into scalable, production-ready AI solutions. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI technologies, model releases, fine-tuning techniques, agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, and CrewAI, and AI evaluation methodologies. 
 - Represent the AI engineering function in technical design reviews, architecture governance forums, and incident post-mortems. 
 - Drive engineering best practices and continuous improvement across AI solution design, development, deployment, monitoring, security, and operational support. 

Required Skills and Qualifications

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on AI/ML solutions in production environments. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with RAG architectures, including vector databases, embedding pipelines, chunking strategies, hybrid search (keyword + semantic), re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation. 
 - Proven track record of building Agentic AI systems, including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, planning loops, memory management, and fallback strategies. 
 - Strong proficiency in Azure Cloud services, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search (formerly Cognitive Search), Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, AKS, and App Service. 
 - Experience troubleshooting AI performance issues, including inference latency optimization, token budgeting, embedding drift detection, hallucination mitigation, and cost management at scale. 
 - Proficiency in Python and at least one of the following: C#/. NET or TypeScript/Node. js. 
 - Experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI. 
 - Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, including transformers, attention mechanisms, fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), RLHF, and evaluation metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, faithfulness, and relevance. 
 - Experience leading engineering teams of 4+ members in an Agile/Scrum environment. 
 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and prepare clear technical documentation. 

Resumes can be shared with devika. raju@kumaran. com

About ETPL

eReleGo Technologies Private Limited (ETPL) is a Bengaluru-based technology company building scalable digital platforms across AdTech, EdTech, SaaS ERP, and FinTech domains. The company focuses on applying advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence and data-driven systems to solve real operational problems for businesses and educational institutions. 

As ETPL scales into a firm of larger size, revenue, and complexity, it is investing deliberately in building strong internal capabilities across leadership, operations, technology, people, and culture. The objective is not just rapid growth, but sustainable, future-ready growth supported by structured systems, strong talent, and accountable teams. 

About Crafter

Crafter is a comprehensive low-code / no-code Enterprise & SaaS platform that helps organizations build custom applications, automate workflows, and streamline core business processes without extensive technical expertise. 

Designed for startups, SMEs, and large enterprises seeking agility and efficiency, Crafter's visual drag-and-drop builder and modular solutions enable businesses to rapidly create applications, manage resources, and enhance customer engagement with minimal coding.   

Role Overview

We are seeking a Staff Engineer with 6 to 9 years of hands-on experience in Java and Spring Boot to provide technical leadership across one or more products within the ETPL AI portfolio. This role sits within ETPL's engineering capability and carries responsibility for backend architecture, system design, engineering quality, and the technical development of delivery teams. 

The Staff Engineer will be the senior technical authority within their product engineering context - owning architectural decisions, driving best practices, and ensuring that the systems they are responsible for are scalable, maintainable, and built to support enterprise-grade deployments. The role combines deep hands-on engineering with the influence and communication skills to lead other engineers and engage meaningfully with product and business stakeholders. 

This is a role for an engineer who has moved beyond individual contribution and is ready to shape how systems are designed, how teams deliver, and how technical quality is defined and maintained across a product. 

Key Responsibilities

- Provide technical leadership in the design, development, and evolution of backend systems and services built on Java and Spring Boot across assigned ETPL AI products
 - Own system architecture decisions for assigned product areas - ensuring scalability, modularity, security, and performance across multi-tenant enterprise deployments
 - Lead and mentor a team of engineers, conducting code reviews, architectural walkthroughs, and technical discussions that raise the capability and quality of the broader team
 - Translate product requirements and business logic into well-structured, maintainable technical designs - collaborating closely with product managers and senior stakeholders to ensure alignment between technical decisions and product outcomes
 - Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and engineering governance frameworks across the product codebase
 - Conduct architectural reviews and deep code audits to identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and structural risks - and lead the resolution of findings in a structured manner
 - Design and optimize data models, database schemas, and query performance across relational databases, particularly MySQL and PostgreSQL, to support high-volume, data-intensive operations
 - Drive the adoption of RESTful API design standards, microservices principles, and service integration patterns appropriate to ETPL's platform architecture
 - Own the technical quality of the software delivery lifecycle within the product team - including requirements validation, design reviews, testing governance, deployment oversight, and post-release monitoring
 - Identify, evaluate, and integrate appropriate libraries, frameworks, and tools to improve engineering efficiency, system reliability, and long-term maintainability
 - Act as the escalation point for critical technical issues and production incidents within the product, leading structured root cause analysis and resolution
 - Champion a culture of engineering excellence, documentation discipline, and continuous improvement within the product engineering team

Experience And Profile

- 6 to 9 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong and sustained depth in Java and Spring Boot
 - Demonstrated experience designing and delivering scalable, high-performance backend systems for enterprise or SaaS products
 - Experience leading or mentoring other engineers within a structured delivery team
 - Proven ability to make and communicate sound architectural decisions across backend systems, APIs, and data layers
 - Experience with microservices architecture, RESTful API design, and distributed systems is expected
 - Prior exposure to multi-tenant platform design or enterprise product engineering is an advantage

Skills And Attributes

- Deep mastery of Java and Spring Boot, with strong expertise in building modular, production-grade enterprise backend systems
 - Solid understanding of Spring ecosystem components - Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud - and their appropriate application in enterprise contexts
 - Strong database engineering skills across relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) including schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning at scale
 - Proficiency in RESTful API design and development, with a clear understanding of API contracts, versioning, and integration standards
 - Experience with microservices architecture, service decomposition, and inter-service communication patterns including REST and message queuing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent)
 - Familiarity with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, and with CI/CD pipeline tooling for structured, automated delivery
 - Proficiency with Git and structured branching strategies for collaborative development within multi-team engineering environments
 - Working knowledge of cloud platforms - AWS / Azure - and the deployment and infrastructure considerations relevant to enterprise SaaS products
 - Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and test-driven development practices, with a commitment to maintaining high automated test coverage
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with structured root cause analysis - particularly under production pressure
 - Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical decisions and trade-offs to both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders
 - A collaborative and mentoring disposition - genuinely invested in the growth of the engineers around them, not just personal technical output

Recruitment Process

ETPL follows a structured, assessment-led recruitment process focused on long-term fit and capability development. Shortlisted candidates will go through: 

- ETPL Aptitude Test (EAT) - to assess analytical ability, reasoning, and problem-solving
 - ETPL Psychometric Test (EPT) - to understand work style, behavioral tendencies, and role alignment
 - Interview Rounds - including functional and culture-fit discussionsThis process ensures fairness, transparency, and clarity for both the candidate and the organization. 

What do we offer

- Exposure to senior educators, institutional leaders, and industry practitioners
 - Opportunities to learn from internal capability-building initiatives and leadership programs
 - A growing organization that is investing in better systems, clearer roles, and stronger people practices
 - A work environment that values learning, ownership, and long-term career growthAs a scaling company, ETPL is evolving its processes, teams, and structures. This role suits individuals who are comfortable growing alongside the organization, contributing to improvement, and building strong foundations rather than expecting everything to be fully polished from day one. 

To apply you can send your resume to prashant. musale@erelego. com or DM me on (LinkedIn or +91-9167464004).

data.title: Lead AI Engineer (LLM Agents)-Immediate
data.description:
Location: Remote (India), working with a San Francisco-based founding team

Engagement: Full-time, long-term, dedicated

Experience: 8-10+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years building production LLM applications and agents

Openings: 1

Time zone: Flexible hours, with a daily live overlap with the founders

About the ClientOur client is an early-stage AI startup in San Francisco, founded by alumni of Harvard and MIT. The company is in stealth. It is building an agent-based product that takes complex, high-stakes paperwork off the hands of US families: working out what applies to them, researching official sources, handling correspondence and following up over weeks, with every step checked and backed by evidence. 

Parts of the product are already built and running in test. The team today is two co-founders and one engineer. As Lead Engineer, you will be the most senior technical person on the team. You will be the founders' technical partner, own the architecture, and lead the product into production with real users. 

The Role: CTO Judgement, Builder's HandsWe are looking for someone with the judgement of a CTO who still writes code every day. Expect roughly 70-80% of your week to be hands-on: designing, building, reviewing and shipping. The rest goes into technical direction, standards and growing the team. 

•      Own the architecture end to end, and be accountable for how the system behaves in production. 

•      Be the founders' technical partner: shape the roadmap, make build-vs-buy calls, size work honestly, and push back when something is the wrong thing to build. 

•      Set the engineering bar for code review, testing, evals, security and releases. 

•      Lead and mentor the engineers on the team, and help interview future hires. 

•      Lead from the front in production: when something breaks, you're on it, and you make sure it doesn't break the same way twice. 

This role is not for you if you haven't shipped production code in the last 12 months, or you'd rather manage engineers than build alongside them. 

What You'll Own•      Agent platform architecture: design the agent harness, with tool-calling loops that have budgets, stop conditions and failure recovery, and a check on every output before it reaches a user or an outside party. 

•      Model layer: route across model vendors with fallbacks, manage prompts and versions, and weigh the cost, latency and quality behind each choice. 

•      Durable, long-running workflows: agent runs that wait days or weeks for a reply, survive restarts and deployments, and can be audited afterwards. 

•      Evaluation and safety: build the eval framework that decides when an agent is correct, when it can act without a person approving, and when it must escalate. Trace and observe every run. 

•      Data, security and compliance: store sensitive personal records securely, with row-level access control, encryption, secrets management and audit trails. Get the platform ready for the security reviews (e. g. SOC 2) that customers and partners will ask for. 

•      Infrastructure and reliability: AWS and Azure architecture, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. Build performance-critical services in Go, Rust or Python where TypeScript is not the right tool. 

•      Full-stack product: you will still ship features end to end, from the agent to the screen a family sees on phone or desktop. 

Milestones•      First 30 days: ship code in week one. Review the existing system, then agree an architecture, a risk list and a 90-day technical plan with the founders. 

•      By 90 days: the core agent harness, eval framework and production infrastructure are in place, and the first real users are live. 

•      By six months: the platform runs in production with real users, with measurable reliability and eval coverage, and the team ships to your standard. 

Core RequirementsSeniority and leadership•      8-10+ years of professional software engineering. In recent years you have worked as a tech lead, principal or staff engineer, founding engineer or CTO in early-stage startups, and still written production code throughout. 

•      You have owned the architecture of a production system from early design through scale, and lived with the consequences of your decisions. 

•      0-to-1 experience: you have taken a product from prototype to real users, at an early-stage startup or on a new product line. 

•      You have led or mentored a small team (2-8 engineers) without big-company process around you. 

Agents and AI systems (hands-on, in production)•      2+ years building LLM applications, including at least one agent system you architected, shipped to real users and ran in production. 

•      Deep understanding of agent architecture: 

-      tool and function calling

-      planning vs. execution, and single vs. multi-agent designs

-      context and memory management

-      human-in-the-loop approvals and guardrails

-      defence against prompt injection

•      You know the frameworks (LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, MCP) well enough to know when to write the loop yourself. 

•      Structured output and failure handling: you get typed, schema-validated output from models, and you handle the cases where the model gets it wrong with retries, repair and fallbacks. 

•      Evaluation at production level: you have built eval sets and graders (including calibrated LLM-as-judge), wired regression gates into CI, and used the results to decide whether to ship. 

•      Running models in production economically: caching, routing, batching, and choosing the right model for each task. 

•      Designing around interfaces, so a model vendor, cloud or database can be swapped without a rewrite. 

Engineering depth•      Expert TypeScript across the stack: Node. js on the server and React in the browser. 

•      Production depth in at least one of Go, Rust or Python. 

•      Designing and running systems on AWS or Azure, with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi). 

•      PostgreSQL: data modelling, query performance and row-level security. 

•      Durable workflow engines and queues in production (e. g. Temporal, Inngest, Step Functions, Celery). 

•      Security engineering for sensitive personal data: threat modelling, access control, encryption, secrets handling and audit logging. 

•      Observability and incident response: tracing, metrics, alerting and post-mortems. 

•      Automated testing as a habit, including tests of behaviour that depends on a model. 

•      Heavy daily use of AI coding tools (e. g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). You set the team's standard for reviewing what they produce. 

Nice to Have•      Hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure. 

•      A previous founder, co-founder or CTO role at a startup. 

•      Research agents that search the web and cite sources; browser automation or voice agents; MCP servers you have built. 

•      Document processing: OCR and pulling data from scans and PDFs. 

•      Compliance work such as SOC 2, HIPAA or GDPR. 

•      Products in high-stakes, regulated areas such as legal, financial, government or healthcare paperwork. 

•      Public repos, technical writing, talks or open-source work on agent systems. This will make your application stand out. 

What We Look For Beyond Code•      A founder mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, owns outcomes, and cares about the people using the product. They are going through a hard time, so every screen, message and automated action matters. 

•      "Evidence before claims": when you say something works, you show the test, the log or the screenshot. 

•      A clear technical communicator: you can explain a trade-off to non-technical founders in plain words, and write a design doc engineers can build from. 

•      Excellent written and spoken English. You are comfortable on video: a daily stand-up with cameras on, plus short recorded video updates. 

•      A reliable internet connection, a quiet workspace, and your own laptop (32 GB RAM preferred, disk encryption on). 

Working HoursThe founders are in San Francisco, and the wider team works across time zones. You should be open to any of these patterns (India time), agreed with the founders: 

•      9: 30 a. m. - 6: 30 p. m. 

•      2: 30 p. m. - 11: 30 p. m. 

•      8: 00 a. m. - 5: 00 p. m. 

Engagement Details•      Full-time, long-term engagement through Metric Tree Labs, working only with this client as part of its core team. 

•      Target start: as early as possible. The joining date is agreed on selection. 

•      Senior, competitive compensation, reviewed after six months.
