data.title: Lead System Designer & Product Security Representative
data.description:
Job Description Summary

We are seeking a Lead System Designer / Product Security Representative (LSD/PSR) to lead compliance, quality, and security governance for Ethos Design System (EDS) by ensuring all components meet QMS, regulatory, and secure development requirements throughout their lifecycle. 

This role ensures that components are designed, developed, verified, released, and maintained in accordance with Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) practices, regulatory expectations, and enterprise security standards. You will serve as the primary compliance steward for EDS, partnering with Product Management, UX, Engineering, Architecture, and Product Security teams to maintain audit readiness, security posture, documentation completeness, and release compliance. This includes complete ownership of QMS documentation, review coordination, approvals, and process compliance activities. 

Job Description

About the Ethos Design System (EDS)

EDS is the unified digital platform that powers GE HealthCare's global software portfolio. It serves as a comprehensive library of reusable UI components, design patterns, and accessibility standards that bridge the critical gap between User Experience (UX) and Engineering. By fostering a philosophy of "reduce, reuse, and recycle, " EDS enables hundreds of product teams to eliminate redundant coding and design work. We provide the foundational building blocks that ensure our clinical and operational applications are intuitive, consistent, and accessible, allowing teams to focus on patient safety. 

The Mission: Scale and Empowerment

We are in a phase of hyper-growth, scaling from 25 adopting products to over 100. This requires a leader who thinks like a founder. You must look beyond simple backlog management to think about scale, growth, and empowerment. You will build a self-service ecosystem that allows teams to move fast without breaking the consistent standards required for patient safety and accessibility. 

Core Responsibilities

- Quality & Compliance
 - QMS Ownership: Own QMS-related activities across the EDS component lifecycle. Set and own the program Design History File (DHF) strategy. 
 - Documentation & Traceability: Develop, maintain, and govern required design, development, verification, and release documentation. Ensure traceability between requirements, design artifacts, implementation, verification, and releases. 
 - Audit Readiness: Coordinate reviews, approvals, and signoffs for quality records. Support audits, assessments, and inspection of readiness activities while maintaining compliance with organizational development processes and regulatory requirements. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Drive continuous improvement of quality processes, templates, and workflows. Ensure component Technical Design Reviews (cTDR/dTDR/eTDR) align with program plans and needs. 
 - Product Security & Secure Development
 - Security Governance: Serve as the Product Security Representative for EDS, ensuring adherence to Secure Development Lifecycle requirements. 
 - Risk Management: Coordinate security reviews, threat modeling, and security risk assessments. Track remediation of vulnerabilities, security findings, and compliance gaps. 
 - Release Validation: Ensure security controls, evidence, and documentation are completed before releases. 
 - Engineering Partnership: Partner with engineering teams to implement secure coding and dependency management practices. Coordinate penetration testing, security scans, SBOM generation, and vulnerability management activities. Track security metrics, remediation SLAs, and compliance status across components. 
 - Governance & Program Oversight
 - Release Readiness: Establish release readiness checklists covering quality and security requirements. Maintain audit-ready records and ensure documentation integrity. 
 - Strategic Liaison: Act as the primary liaison between EDS teams, Quality, Regulatory, and Product Security organizations. Collaborate with Product, Architecture, UX, and Engineering to identify compliance risks and mitigation plans. 
 - Automation: Drive automation of QMS and security compliance processes where practical. Monitor compliance with KPIs and provide status reporting to leadership. 

Qualifications

- Experience: 10+ years of experience with Quality Management Systems (QMS) and regulated product development. 
 - Mandatory: Strong understanding of Secure Development Lifecycle practices. 
 - Mandatory: Experience coordinating security reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability management, and compliance activities. 
 - Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with design controls, traceability, audit readiness, and release governance. 
 - Process & Methodology: Experience in Agile Software Development, including associated concepts, tools, and practices. Ability to drive process improvements and compliance automation initiatives. 
 - AI Tooling: Experience using AI tools is a must to enhance workflows, optimize compliance checks, or assist in documentation generation. 
 - Leadership Skills: Strong cross-functional leadership, stakeholder management, and program coordination skills. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
Inclusion And Diversity

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. 

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviours: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership - always with unyielding integrity. 

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you'd expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you'll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

data.title: Staff Engineer, CPU Core Verification
data.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities. 

At Tenstorrent, we build open, state of the art compute for real workloads and real developers. You will own CPU core‐level verification, shaping how our out‐of‐order RISC‐V CPUs behave in silicon. 

This role is hybrid, based out of Bangalore, India. 

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting. 

Who You Are

- You bring 8+ years in CPU verification or closely related digital design. 
 - You know high‐performance out‐of‐order CPU microarchitecture in depth. 
 - You work comfortably with RTL, waveforms, logs, and complex debug scenarios. 
 - You communicate clearly across design, DV, emulation, and post‐silicon teams. 

What We Need

- Plan and drive functional verification for CPU core features and complex microarchitectural scenarios. 
 - Develop UVM, assembly, and C/C++ based stimulus, functional models, and coverage for ISA, RISC-V extensions, and un-core components. 
 - Debug simulation and emulation regressions using RTL understanding, waveforms, and logs to identify and resolve issues efficiently. 
 - Build and enhance coverage models, testbenches, and debug infrastructure to improve verification quality and coverage closure. 
 - Collaborate with design, validation, and test teams to support bring-up and delivery of robust CPU cores and clusters. 

What You Will Learn

- How Tenstorrent designs and validates high‐performance RISC‐V CPU cores and clusters. 
 - Techniques for spanning pre‐silicon, emulation, and post‐silicon verification with shared stimulus. 
 - Ways to scale coverage, debug, and infrastructure across multiple CPU programs. 
 - How open hardware and software fit into Tenstorrent's broader compute roadmap. 

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer. 

This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U. S. export-controlled technology. Due to U. S. export laws, including those codified in the U. S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D: 1, E1, and E2). These requirements apply to persons located in the U. S. and all countries outside the U. S. As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U. S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency. If employment is not possible due to U. S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.

data.description:
Who are Inchcape

At Inchcape Shipping Services, our vision is to create a connected world where customers can trade successfully and make informed decisions in every port, everywhere. We achieve this by combining our worldwide infrastructure with local expertise, through our global network of more than 250 proprietary offices and a team of over 3, 000 dedicated professionals. Our diverse customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors, as well as naval, government, and intergovernmental organizations. 

We have an ambitious growth model, and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills & experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry. 

Contract Type : Fixed term contract - 6 months

Main Purpose of Job: 

To analyze the system application, business requirements and responsible for the development and execution of test plan, test scenarios, test cases and quality control process to improve product quality for delivering defect free high quality software systems exceeding business expectations for ISS. 

Duties and Responsibilities: 

- Review and understand end to end business requirements, System/Application design, Integration, and functionalities/feature. 
 - Review and understand enterprise & solution architectures, design implementation of new features end-to-end considering both functional & non-functional requirements and the entire tech stack - frontend, backend, database, middleware, AWS, and DevOps
 - Effectively contribute to test plan creation, test strategy creation, develop test scenarios, develop test cases, collect test data, create test batches, perform test cases, report defects, track defect. 
 - Partner with other automation engineers to create a unified approach to automation across the team

 - Practice DevOps with automation first mindset, with excellent understanding of branching strategies, version control, best configuration, testing practices, build management, CI/CD pipeline. 

Person Specification : 

Knowledge

Skills : 

- Test Automation, Test Driven Development methodology, C#. NET, XUnit, TestRail, Sonar Cloud, Selenium, Rest Sharp, Shift Left testing principles

 - Excellent analytical, problem solving and trouble shooting skills
 - Strong collaborative and partner approach
 - Software engineering skills with high tech resilience

 - DevOps mindset and Live site first approach

Experience : 

- 5 - 8 years in Software testing and quality assurance including both manual and automation testing. 
 - Creating and executing test plan, test cases, test scenarios, automate testing for software products.

Why Inchcape Shipping Services?

We believe in building a diverse and high-performing workforce that works together to provide our customers with the exceptional service they deserve. To reach the highest standards, we depend on our people, their welfare, training and expertise. We realize the value of our staff and know that your unique experiences, skills and passions will help you to build a rich and rewarding career in our dynamic industry. 

Our values are at the cente of everything we do, and the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate and fully adopt these: 

Global Perspective - we connect the world and see the bigger picture. 

The Power of People - we rely on the strength of local agent knowledge and relationships. 

Progress - we adopt new thinking and push for positive change in our industry.

Plus, much more!

If you think that you have the right skills, knowledge and attitude to join our team, then we invite you to apply by simply clicking at the top of this advert!

#ISSthebiggerpicture

Inchcape is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and equality, diversity and inclusion are at the centre of everything we do. We recognise that our customers, colleagues, contractors and other partners are central to our success and that we work in a diverse society. data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer (Development & Quality)
data.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. 

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. 

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Senior Staff Software Engineer in Test, Endpoint Agent (Development & Automation Testing)

Why Kaseya?

Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated by combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices. 

You will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology architecture, but also how engineering teams leverage AI to build high-quality software faster and more effectively. 

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer to help develop and maintain Kaseya's endpoint management agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms. 

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on building secure, reliable, and scalable endpoint management capabilities. The ideal candidate is passionate about operating systems, systems programming, device management, endpoint security, and software quality. 

Unlike traditional development environments where quality ownership is separated, our engineers own the full software lifecycle. You will design, develop, test, deploy, and support your solutions while building automated validation alongside the features you create. Successful candidates combine strong software engineering skills with a quality-first mindset and leverage automation to ensure reliability, maintainability, and release confidence at scale. 

What You Will Do

- Design and implement new features for endpoint agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms. 
 - Develop software components supporting monitoring, automation, patching, inventory collection, remote actions, scripting, and device management. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. 
 - Own features throughout the entire lifecycle from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Build automated tests and validation frameworks alongside feature development. 
 - Develop automated coverage for functional, integration, regression, resiliency, and system-level scenarios. 
 - Improve software quality through testability, diagnostics, telemetry, and automation. 
 - Investigate customer-reported issues and production escalations. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventative solutions to avoid future recurrence. 
 - Reproduce complex issues across diverse operating system and endpoint environments. 
 - Improve agent stability, performance, scalability, security, and reliability. 
 - Develop integrations with operating system management, security frameworks, and device management APIs. 
 - Build telemetry and diagnostics capabilities that improve product supportability and troubleshooting. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Support, Cloud Platform, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver customer-focused solutions. 
 - Participate in design discussions, code reviews, architecture reviews, and sprint planning activities. 
 - Utilize AI-assisted development and testing tools to accelerate engineering productivity and improve software quality. 

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

- 12+ years of software engineering experience developing system software, endpoint software, platform services, or related applications. 
 - Strong proficiency in C# and . NET, including experience building production-grade applications and services. 
 - Experience building automated tests and validation capabilities as part of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Experience developing automated test frameworks and validation tooling using technologies such as xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, Selenium, Playwright or similar testing frameworks 
 - Experience with Windows system programming concepts such as Win32 APIs, Windows Services, WMI, Registry operations, process management, threading, security models, or related operating system capabilities. 
 - Strong knowledge of operating system fundamentals, including: Processes and threads, Filesystems, Networking, Services and daemons, Security models, Privilege management, Performance and resource utilization 
 - Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills. 
 - Experience developing software that interacts with operating system services, APIs, or management frameworks. 
 - Understanding of software quality engineering principles, test automation, and CI/CD practices. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as coding assistants, code generation tools, or intelligent debugging solutions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with RMM, UEM, EDR, XDR, endpoint security, or device management products. 
 - Knowledge of C, C++, Rust, Go 
 - Experience with Microsoft Intune, Apple MDM, Android Enterprise, or Linux management platforms. 
 - Knowledge of PowerShell, Bash, Python, AppleScript, or other scripting technologies. 
 - Experience building test frameworks, automation libraries, or system-level validation tooling. 
 - Experience working with virtualization, containerization, or automated device provisioning environments. 
 - Familiarity with endpoint telemetry, diagnostics, observability, and monitoring systems. 

What Success Looks Like

A successful Senior Endpoint Software Engineer at Kaseya: 

- Builds secure, scalable, and high-quality endpoint software. 
 - Owns features end-to-end from design through production support. 
 - Demonstrates strong ownership of both software development and quality. 
 - Develops automated validation alongside feature implementation. 
 - Solves complex customer, platform, and operating system challenges. 
 - Improves the reliability, performance, security, and maintainability of endpoint agents. 
 - Rapidly diagnoses issues and implements long-term corrective solutions. 
 - Partners effectively across Product, Support, Security, Platform, and Engineering teams. 
 - Leverages AI-native engineering practices to improve productivity and accelerate delivery. 
 - Continuously grows expertise in operating systems, endpoint management, systems programming, and modern software development practices. 

Additional Information

Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Join us as a Test Engineer at Barclays where you will contribute to the delivery of high-quality technology solutions by planning, designing, executing, and improving functional, non-functional, regression, automation, SIT and UAT testing activities. The role will support the continuous expansion and improvement of the test suite, ensure adherence to testing standards and governance, and work closely with business, technology, QA, development, and stakeholder teams to validate that solutions meet agreed business requirements and quality expectations. 

To be successful as a Test Engineer, you should have experience with: 

- Experience in software testing, quality assurance, test automation or related technology delivery roles. 
 - Strong understanding of the software testing lifecycle, software development lifecycle and core testing processes, techniques and methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience in functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, API testing and automation testing. 
 - Strong knowledge of test design techniques, test estimation, test scenario creation, test case preparation, test execution, defect logging, defect verification and test reporting. 
 - Hands-on experience with automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Cucumber, TestNG, REST Assured, Karate, AutomatePro or equivalent tools. 
 - Good working knowledge of programming or scripting languages such as Java, Python or similar technologies. 
 - Understanding of BDD concepts and practical experience in automation development and execution. 
 - Awareness of CI/CD and DevOps practices, including Jenkins or equivalent pipeline tools. 
 - Experience using source code control tools such as Git, GitLab, Bitbucket or equivalent. 
 - Experience with test management and defect management tools such as JIRA, ALM, Xray, Zephyr, ServiceNow or equivalent. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex requirements and identify quality risks. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with global teams and stakeholders on test progress, risks and outcomes. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an Agile environment, managing assigned activities with accountability and attention to detail. 
 - Strong focus on quality, governance, documentation, traceability and continuous improvement. 

Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include

- Experience working on banking, financial services, risk, control, compliance, regulatory or investment banking applications. 
 - Exposure to ServiceNow, IRM, control technology platforms, reporting workflows or enterprise risk systems. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipeline integration and automated regression execution. 
 - Domain, testing or technical certifications such as ISTQB, Selenium, Agile, DevOps or equivalent would be an advantage. 
 - Experience contributing to QA process improvements, automation strategy, regression pack uplift, defect management improvements or quality engineering practices. 

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. 

The role is based out of Pune and/or Chennai. 

Purpose of the role

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer to help develop and maintain Kaseya's endpoint management agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms. 

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on building secure, reliable, and scalable endpoint management capabilities. The ideal candidate is passionate about operating systems, systems programming, device management, endpoint security, and software quality. 

Unlike traditional development environments where quality ownership is separated, our engineers own the full software lifecycle.  - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.

 - Build automated tests and validation frameworks alongside feature development. 
 - Develop automated coverage for functional, integration, regression, resiliency, and system-level scenarios. 
 - Improve software quality through testability, diagnostics, telemetry, and automation. 
 - Investigate customer-reported issues and production escalations. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventative solutions to avoid future recurrence. 
 - Reproduce complex issues across diverse operating system and endpoint environments. 
 - Improve agent stability, performance, scalability, security, and reliability. 
 - Develop integrations with operating system management, security frameworks, and device management APIs. 
 - Build telemetry and diagnostics capabilities that improve product supportability and troubleshooting. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Support, Cloud Platform, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver customer-focused solutions. 
 - Participate in design discussions, code reviews, architecture reviews, and sprint planning activities. 
 - Utilize AI-assisted development and testing tools to accelerate engineering productivity and improve software quality. 

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of software engineering experience developing system software, endpoint software, platform services, or related applications. 
 - Strong proficiency in C# and . NET, including experience building production-grade applications and services. 
 - Experience building automated tests and validation capabilities as part of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Experience developing automated test frameworks and validation tooling using technologies such as xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, Selenium, Playwright or similar testing frameworks 
 - Experience with Windows system programming concepts such as Win32 APIs, Windows Services, WMI, Registry operations, process management, threading, security models, or related operating system capabilities. 
 - Strong knowledge of operating system fundamentals, including: Processes and threads, Filesystems, Networking, Services and daemons, Security models, Privilege management, Performance and resource utilization 
 - Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills. 
 - Experience developing software that interacts with operating system services, APIs, or management frameworks. 
 - Understanding of software quality engineering principles, test automation, and CI/CD practices. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as coding assistants, code generation tools, or intelligent debugging solutions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with RMM, UEM, EDR, XDR, endpoint security, or device management products. 
 - Knowledge of C, C++, Rust, Go 
 - Experience with Microsoft Intune, Apple MDM, Android Enterprise, or Linux management platforms. 
 - Knowledge of PowerShell, Bash, Python, AppleScript, or other scripting technologies. 
 - Experience building test frameworks, automation libraries, or system-level validation tooling. 
 - Experience working with virtualization, containerization, or automated device provisioning environments. 
 - Familiarity with endpoint telemetry, diagnostics, observability, and monitoring systems. 

What Success Looks Like

A successful Senior Endpoint Software Engineer at Kaseya: 

- Builds secure, scalable, and high-quality endpoint software. 
 - Owns features end-to-end from design through production support. 
 - Demonstrates strong ownership of both software development and quality. 
 - Develops automated validation alongside feature implementation. 
 - Solves complex customer, platform, and operating system challenges. 
 - Improves the reliability, performance, security, and maintainability of endpoint agents. 
 - Rapidly diagnoses issues and implements long-term corrective solutions. 
 - Partners effectively across Product, Support, Security, Platform, and Engineering teams. 
 - Leverages AI-native engineering practices to improve productivity and accelerate delivery. 
 - Continuously grows expertise in operating systems, endpoint management, systems programming, and modern software development practices. 

Additional Information

Title: Staff/Senior Staff Physical Design Engineer (Technical Lead)

Location Greater Bengaluru/Hybrid/Remote

About Company: 

We are hiring for organization which is leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge-to-cloud computing. Its robust and scalable next-generation in-memory computing technology provides orders-of-magnitude higher compute efficiency and density compared to today's best-in-class solutions. The high-performance architecture is coupled with seamless software integration and will enable the immense potential of AI to be accessible in power, energy, and space constrained applications. It was launched in 2022 and is led by veteran technologists with backgrounds in semiconductor design and AI systems. 

Job Description: 

Experience: 

Staff 8-10 years

Senior Staff 11-13 years

The Role

We are seeking a high-impact Staff/Senior Staff Physical Design Engineer to serve as a Technical Lead for our next-generation silicon products. 

This is a "player-coach" role designed for a versatile expert who is equally comfortable architecting a convergence strategy as they are mentoring a small team of engineers. 

You will own the physical delivery of a major sub-chip or complex block, pushing the absolute limits of PPA (Power, Performance, Area). 

As a Staff/Senior Staff lead, you are expected to be the "anchor" of the project-assertive in your decision-making, highly analytical in your debugging, 

and adept at managing stakeholders to ensure we hit our tape-out milestones without compromise. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership: Lead a small team of PD engineers, providing technical direction, workload management, and architectural oversight for a sub-chip or partition. SOC clocking , FEV/VCLP specialized skills are preferred. 

- Complex Block/Sub-chip Ownership: Take personal hands-on ownership of the most critical, high-congestion, or timing-critical blocks in the design. 
 - Timing & PPA Strategy: Act as the primary architect for PD convergence. Derive and implement custom "PPA recipes" that go beyond standard vendor flows to meet aggressive targets. 
 - Advanced Automation: Drive efficiency across the team by developing sophisticated Tcl and Python scripts for flow automation, data mining, and sign-off verification. 
 - Stakeholder Management: Build strong rapport with RTL, DFT, and Synthesis teams. Effectively communicate risks and push for "left-shift" optimizations to safeguard the project schedule. 
 - Sign-off Accountability: Ensure the sub-chip meets all gold-standard sign-off criteria, including STA, EM/IR (Voltus/Apache), and Physical Verification (Pegasus/Calibre). 

Technical Requirements

Requirement

Experience

Staff 8-10 years

Senior Staff 11-13 years

PD experience with a proven track record of multiple successful lead-level tape-outs. 

Tool Mastery

Expert-level proficiency in Cadence Innovus/Tempus

Timing Convergence

When 5% of Indian households shop with us, it's important to build resilient systems to manage millions of orders every day. We've done this - with zero downtime!Sounds impossible? Who We Are

Magnit is the future of work. Serving hundreds of the world's most recognizable brands for the past 30+ years, Magnit offers the industry's first holistic platform for the modern workforce. At Magnit, you'll work with passionate colleagues who collaborate and deliver meaningful results that positively transform the largest companies around the globe. 

As Director of Engineering for Operations & AI Automation, you'll own the engine room of the Magnit Global VMS platform, the systems that power clients, suppliers and workers with intelligent workflows, and the data layer underneath. You'll lead 3-4 teams building agentic capabilities, automation, and insights that turn manual operational work into product. You'll set technical direction, raise the engineering bar, and partner closely with Product, Operations to ship outcomes that customers feel. 

This is both hands-on-the-keyboard, hands-on-the-strategy role for a leader who has shipped real AI into production, not slideware, and who knows the difference between a demo and a system that large number of enterprise users depend on at 9am Monday. 

What you'll do

- Lead the org. Manage and grow 3-4 engineering teams across the product line. Hire, coach, and develop managers and senior ICs. 
 - Set technical direction. Own architecture, delivery priorities, and engineering standards across your teams. Make the trade-offs that matter, build vs. buy, speed vs. reliability, automation vs. headcount. 
 - Build with AI, not around it. Ship production-grade AI agents, RAG systems, workflow orchestration, and tool-calling capabilities. Drive measurable reduction in manual work and meaningful lift in operational accuracy. 
 - Turn operations into product. Partner with Product, Operations to convert recurring operational pain into reusable platform capabilities, anomaly detection, intelligent reporting, decision support, automated workflows. 
 - Raise the engineering bar. Drive excellence across architecture, code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, security, and release management. Improve delivery predictability and platform reliability quarter over quarter. 
 - Use data as a product asset. Mine platform data for risk signals, efficiency gaps, and product opportunities. Make data-driven prioritization the default, not the exception. 
 - Plan capacity, ruthlessly. Balance roadmap delivery, automation investment, technical debt paydown, and innovation across teams. Defend the long-term while shipping the quarter. 
 - Build the culture. Establish clear ownership, high standards, and a high-performance, low-drama team culture. Develop the next layer of engineering leaders under you. 

What you'll bring

- 10+ years of engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams (managers reporting to you is a plus). 
 - Track record of leading teams that built and scaled enterprise SaaS platforms, VMS, workforce management, procurement, FinOps, HR Tech, or workflow automation. 
 - Practical, production experience with AI agents, GenAI, RAG, agent orchestration, tool-calling, and AI evaluation. You've shipped this in front of real users, not just prototyped it. 
 - Strong fluency in cloud platforms (AWS), microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, DevOps, and observability. 
 - Demonstrated ability to improve engineering quality, delivery predictability, platform stability, and team performance and the metrics to prove it. 
 - Strong product mindset. You connect technology decisions to customer value and business outcomes, and you push back when the math doesn't work. 
 - A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineering talent, including managers. 

Nice to have

- Domain depth in worker engagement, vendor/staffing operations, or enterprise workflow automation. 
 - Experience shipping analytics, dashboards, anomaly detection, recommendation engines, or conversational insights at scale. 
 - Experience operating global, multi-region platforms across diverse customer segments. 

What Magnit Will Offer You

At Magnit, you'll be joining an innovative, high-growth environment and can quickly make an impact to help transform the largest companies in the world. You will work with passionate colleagues who collaborate and deliver. Magnit offers all employees the opportunity for growth and development, and we want individuals to fulfill their potential and blaze their own trails!

Magnit will offer you a competitive PTO and benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement planning, as well as discounts and perks for tickets, travel, merchandise and more! Magnit encourages employees to participate in giving back, and we will match employee contributions to favorite charities and support corporate volunteering hours to make a difference in your community!

data.title: Member of Technical Staff (Senior - Specialized Indexing)
data.description:
Category-defining tech. Career-defining work. 

For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed. 

At Cockroach Labs, you'll solve problems that didn't exist five years ago alongside people who believe the simplest solutions often require the most sophisticated thinking. Your work will run in production at some of the most innovative companies in the world. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity. 

The Role

The SQL Queries team is responsible for the core of CockroachDB's query execution and optimization layer. This group designs and delivers features that make our distributed SQL engine fast, reliable, and flexible for a wide range of workloads. 

AI is transforming how we search, learn, and build, and databases are evolving to keep up. 

We're forming a new Specialized Indexing subteam within SQL Queries to expand CockroachDB's indexing capabilities beyond traditional relational workloads. This team will design and implement high-performance indexing systems such as vector, full-text, and geospatial indexes to support the next generation of AI-native and search-driven applications. 

As part of this team, you'll work on deep systems problems, collaborate across the SQL organization, and build production-quality features that make CockroachDB a unified platform for both structured and unstructured data. 

You Will

- Design, build, and maintain specialized indexing features for CockroachDB, including vector, full-text, and geospatial indexing. 
 - Improve the performance and reliability of existing vector indexing systems, including backfill, query planning, and import workflows. 
 - Partner with other database teams to integrate new indexing mechanisms into the query engine. 
 - Develop hybrid search capabilities that combine vector similarity and text-based search for modern AI and search workloads. 
 - Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and release planning within the SQL organization. 
 - Take full ownership of your work, from design through implementation, testing, and release. 

The Expectations

In your first month, you'll get familiar with CockroachDB's SQL architecture, vector indexing implementation, and the surrounding systems. You'll also begin contributing to smaller improvements and fixes. 

Within three months, you'll take ownership of components related to specialized indexing, making measurable improvements to performance and reliability. 

After six months, you'll play a key role in advancing hybrid search capabilities and help shape the roadmap for future indexing and search features. 

You Have

- Passion for databases, indexing systems, and high-performance distributed architectures. 
 - A strong background in backend or systems programming, preferably with Go, C/C++, or Rust. 
 - Experience working on indexing or query execution systems such as vector, text, or spatial search. 
 - Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems. 
 - Curiosity about AI-driven and hybrid workloads that combine structured and unstructured data. 
 - A focus on building reliable, maintainable, and high-performance software. 
 - Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with a distributed global team. 
 - Typically 10+ years of experience building large-scale, production-grade systems. 
 - Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous problems into scalable, production-grade AI-enabled solutions. 
 - A builder's instinct for reuse and extensibility - your output becomes a platform, pattern, or capability others depend on. 
 - Clear judgment about where AI should be deeply integrated and where traditional approaches are more reliable. 

The Team

The SQL Queries team is one of the most impactful and technically challenging groups at Cockroach Labs. Joining the Specialized Indexing subteam means working at the frontier of databases and AI, helping shape how CockroachDB powers intelligent, hybrid applications. 

You'll be part of a small, autonomous team based in India, collaborating with engineers and leaders across the world. You'll have the chance to own complex, high-visibility features that directly influence how customers use CockroachDB. 

If you're excited about building innovative systems that push the boundaries of what a database can do, we'd love to meet you. 

Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at accessibility@cockroachlabs. com. 

Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Thursdays, and Fridays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we've learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work. 

Benefits

- Medical Insurance
 - Flexible Time Off
 - Paid Parental Leave
 - Mental Wellbeing Benefits
 - Internet Reimbursement
 - Wellness Allowance
 - Food Allowance 
 - Office Commute Reimbursement
 - And more!

data.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 

- Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

About The Role

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across your team and adjacent teams, solving the highest-scope and most complex problems in your area. You will lead large, cross-cutting backend initiatives, drive our modular architecture strategy, and define the standards that let teams move faster without compromising quality, security, reliability, or operability. 

This is a technical leadership role that combines deep backend expertise, systems judgment, product judgment, and influence across organizational boundaries. You will work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, Security, Data, Engineering Managers, and engineers across product groups, bringing subject matter expertise, and you will do it without relying on formal authority. 

Why you'll love this role

- Leverage: Your work multiplies across teams. The platforms, standards, and architectural decisions you lead determine how quickly everyone else can ship. 
 - Genuinely Hard Problems: You'll lead the modernization of a large monolith toward modular, reusable, appropriately independent systems - at the scale of a platform used by millions of users. 
 - Influence Without Bureaucracy: You'll shape technical direction across teams through clear written proposals and decision records, and partner with Product and Engineering leadership on platform roadmap and investment trade-offs. 
 - Frontier AI Work: You'll lead adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows and define the review, quality, security, and privacy guardrails that make them safe to rely on. 
 - Autonomy: You'll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success. 

What You'll Do

- Lead Cross-Cutting Initiatives: Lead the technical design and delivery of large backend initiatives that span teams, and identify and remove systemic bottlenecks across product and infrastructure groups. 
 - Own Architecture Strategy: Drive modular backend, service, data, and platform architecture. Lead modernization of the monolith and legacy backends toward modular, reusable, and appropriately independently operated systems - while preventing fragmentation and service sprawl. 
 - Set the Standards: Define and improve standards for APIs, contracts, compatibility, schema evolution, testing, security, performance, observability, operability, and maintainability - plus the build, test, deploy, release, rollback, and production-readiness practices needed to operate modular features safely. 
 - Establish Shared Patterns: Create the patterns for dependency management, data ownership, eventing, failure isolation, service maturity, and operational documentation. Establish Go service patterns and Kubernetes operating practices where they matter to our production estate, and guide Rust adoption where it solves a real systems, security, performance, or supply-chain problem. 
 - Own What You Build in Production: Take part in on-call and incident response for the systems your teams own, act as a technical escalation point during complex incidents, and turn what you learn into architectural and operational improvements that prevent recurrence. 
 - Influence and Partner: Shape technical direction across teams without formal authority, and partner with Product and Engineering leadership on platform-level roadmap decisions and investment trade-offs. 
 - Grow Engineers: Mentor Senior and Intermediate engineers, shepherd technical debt reduction and reusable patterns that improve throughput, and raise the technical capability of the wider team. 
 - Lead AI Adoption: Lead team-level adoption of AI-assisted and agentic workflows, including the quality, security, privacy, and operational guardrails, and help engineers direct, validate, reject, and course-correct agent output. 

What You'll Bring

- Cross-Team Technical Leadership: A sustained record of technical leadership across more than one team or a broad product area. 
 - Deep Architecture Experience: Deep backend architecture and production experience in complex applications, services, or platforms, including scaling or governing APIs, service platforms, data systems, modular monoliths, or shared backend components. 
 - Modularization in Production: Experience modernizing a monolith or legacy backend architecture in production, and with modular architecture such as bounded contexts, package encapsulation, ports and adapters, service extraction, event-driven boundaries, or an equivalent approach. 
 - Influence Without Authority: A strong ability to create alignment through clear written proposals and decision records, so decisions are documented, understood, and adopted without constant escalation. 
 - Product Judgment: The ability to balance customer outcomes, delivery speed, technical health, reliability, and long-term platform investment. 
 - Mentorship: Experience mentoring engineers and shaping standards through code review, documentation, and example. 
 - Agentic AI Leadership: Production experience with AI-assisted or agentic engineering workflows, including the ability to evaluate and improve how a team adopts them. 

Helpful Experience

- Go services and APIs at scale. 
 - Kubernetes and cloud-native operations, including deployment, scaling, observability, rollback, and production readiness. 
 - Rust adoption or production ownership for systems, security, performance, or platform components. 
 - Ruby/Rails modularization and large-monolith modernization. 
 - PostgreSQL scaling, data partitioning, queues, messaging, or distributed systems. 
 - Security-sensitive product or software supply chain engineering. 
 - Experience across SaaS, single-tenant, self-managed, or air-gapped deployment constraints. 

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
 - Flexible Paid Time Off 
 - Team Member Resource Groups
 - Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
 - Growth and Development Fund
 - Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. 

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. 

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab's policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. data.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. 

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. 

Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data - from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. 

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. 

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. 

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. 

About The Role

dbt Fusion is building the next generation of data execution and connectivity infrastructure, enabling dbt workloads to run efficiently across diverse compute engines and data platforms. As a Senior Engineer on the Fusion Adapters and Connectivity team, you'll design and ship core abstractions powering how dbt communicates with execution systems - leveraging Rust, Go, Arrow, and emerging open standards. This is a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of systems programming, database internals, and high-visibility open-source development. Your work will shape a foundational platform leveraged across the dbt ecosystem and the broader data community. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and maintain Rust-first connectivity layers, execution APIs, and adapter scaffolding. 
 - Partner with teams building the dbt compiler, semantic layer, and runtime to evolve adapter interfaces and system boundaries. 
 - Contribute to Arrow/ADBC and other open-source specifications or implementations, strengthening the data ecosystem. 
 - Own CI, testing frameworks, profiling, error reporting surfaces, and release readiness for Fusion adapters. 
 - Debug complex interoperability and performance issues across drivers, engines, and compute domains. 
 - Collaborate with internal and community maintainers to review PRs, write RFCs, and evolve public code architectures. 
 - Mentor engineers on systems best practices and contribute to shared patterns around resilience, debuggability, and API clarity. 

Skills We're Looking For

- Strong programming background in Rust, Go, C++ or similar performance-oriented languages. 
 - Experience designing or maintaining SDKs, libraries, connectors, or compute/data integration codebases. 
 - Exposure to data warehouses, query engines, Arrow/columnar ecosystems, or execution runtimes. 
 - A desire to build foundational platform components that other teams and community members rely on. 
 - Comfort working in public code review loops, async-first communication, and collaborative RFC processes. 
 - A mindset grounded in debuggability, reliability, and ownership in ambiguous problem spaces. 

You'll have an edge if you have: 

- Contributed to or interacted with Arrow, ADBC, DuckDB, Presto, DataFusion, Spark, ClickHouse, or similar engines. 
 - Experience shaping adapter/plugin standards, driver contracts, or architectural interfaces used by others. 
 - Familiarity with Rust async ecosystems (tokio, tower, tracing) or Go concurrency practices. 
 - Prior OSS governance experience - triaging issues, reviewing PRs, or working with community maintainers. 
 - An interest in building developer-experience layers or scaffolding frameworks for adapter authors. 

Qualifications: 

- 6+ years experience in software engineering, with strong systems-level skills. 
 - 2+ years working in open-source, SDK, runtime, or low-level integration environments. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / related field or equivalent experience through industry OSS contributions. 

Perks And Benefits

100% employer-paid medical insurance
 - Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
