data.title: Technical Lead & Manager
data.description:
We are WisdomAI. 

We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity. 

WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn't just surface insights - it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context. 

We're trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik - and we're just getting started. The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you're compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you'll thrive here. 

The Role

We're looking for our first Technical Lead & Manager in India. This role will help shape the next chapter of that organization while remaining deeply involved in the technical work itself. 

How We Work

Hands-On Leadership

We don't see management and engineering as separate tracks. Our Technical lead will participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, hiring decisions, and occasionally jump into code themselves. The ideal balance is roughly 40% leadership and 60% technical contribution. 

Ownership

Both the geographies - India and US - own meaningful parts of the product and platform. Engineers are trusted with end-to-end ownership and leaders are expected to create the environment where that ownership thrives. 

Talent Density

We're intentional about every hire. The team includes engineers from companies such as Google, Meta, Rubrik, Glean, and other world-class organizations. Maintaining and raising that bar is one of the most important responsibilities of this role. 

Product Thinking

The best engineering decisions start with understanding the customer problem. We look for leaders who can connect technical choices to customer outcomes and help teams prioritize accordingly. 

Builders

We value people who can build from first principles. Processes, operating rhythms, performance management, career development, organizational design-none of these are finished products. You'll help create and evolve them as the organization grows. 

What You'd Work On

Scaling a High-Performance Engineering Organization

The India team has grown rapidly and now spans backend systems, platform infrastructure, frontend experiences, and machine learning. 

You'll help build the systems that allow that team to scale without losing speed, quality, or culture. 

Developing Future Technical Leaders

Many of our engineers are capable of becoming future staff engineers, tech leads, and engineering managers. 

A significant part of this role is helping them get there through mentorship, coaching, feedback, and career development. 

Raising the Hiring Bar

We're actively growing. 

You'll partner closely with leadership to identify exceptional talent, evaluate candidates, and ensure every hire improves the organization. 

Driving Technical Excellence

As the organization grows, maintaining a high technical bar becomes harder. 

You'll help guide architecture discussions, participate in design reviews, review code, and ensure engineering quality scales alongside headcount. 

Building the Next Generation of Analytics

From agent orchestration and reasoning systems to distributed data infrastructure and AI-powered user experiences, you'll work alongside the team solving technically ambitious problems at the intersection of AI, data, and enterprise software. 

You may be a good fit if you

- Have spent years building and shipping complex software systems
 - Have managed engineers and genuinely enjoy helping people grow
 - Still love engineering and want to remain technically involved
 - Hold a high bar for technical quality and execution
 - Operate with high ownership and low ego
 - Can balance speed with sound engineering judgment
 - Have strong product instincts and care about customer outcomes
 - Want to help build an organization, not simply inherit one

Strong candidates may also have

- Experience at companies that have built at scale and have strong engineering cultures
 - Startup or founding engineer experience
 - Experience scaling engineering organizations from
 - Experience with distributed systems, infrastructure, AI, data platforms, or developer tools
 - Experience hiring and developing senior engineering talent

Not sure this is the right fit?

- Looking for a pure people-management role with little technical involvement? This probably isn't it. 
 - Looking for a remote role? We work together in-office five days a week. 
 - Looking primarily for title progression? We're more interested in builders than titles. 

Why WisdomAI?

You'll join a company founded by repeat entrepreneurs and early builders from companies including Rubrik and Glean. 

We're tackling one of the largest software categories in the world: business intelligence and analytics. 

We're backed by leading investors including Kleiner Perkins and NVIDIA Ventures. 

Most importantly, you'll inherit a strong team and have the opportunity to shape what engineering leadership looks like in India from the ground up. 

Our CRAFT

CRAFT isn't a list of aspirational values. It's how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves. 

C - Customer trust. Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust - never the other way around. 

R - Relentless on outcomes. We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn't the measure - results are. If something isn't working, we change the approach now. 

A - Authenticity. We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together. 

F - First principles, grounded in reality. We don't accept "that's how it's done. " We strip problems to what's actually true and build up from there - then validate quickly and let real-world results decide. 

T - Transparency. We share the why, not just the what. When something can't be shared, we say so. We're one team - information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we're wrong. 

Equal opportunity employer

WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

data.title: Lead Engineer - SIEM & Detection Platforms
data.description:
Job Title: Lead Engineer - SIEM & Detection Platforms

GCL: E

Introduction To Role

Are you ready to build and lead enterprise-grade detections that stop real attacks before they impact patients and critical operations? As Lead Engineer for SIEM and Detection Platforms in Chennai, you will develop methods to identify, investigate, and neutralize threats. These threats span cloud services, local infrastructure, and OT/ICS environments. Your work will enable our teams to move faster and more safely as we deliver life-changing medicines. 

You will be the technical driver behind our detection strategy and content, elevating our platforms and practices while partnering with incident responders, threat intelligence, and engineering teams worldwide. Can you envision setting the standard for detection-as-code, scaling coverage across diverse technologies, and turning threat intelligence into high-fidelity signals that matter?

Accountabilities

Detection Strategy and Leadership: Lead end-to-end detection engineering initiatives spanning threat coverage, crafting detection algorithms, and efficacy validation across SIEM, EDR, NDR, and cloud-native services; ensure focus on the most significant threats and measurable outcomes. 

Apply detailed approaches to detection engineering to improve defensive posture, reduce false positives, and accelerate threat identification. Adapt proven strategies to our enterprise context. 

Enterprise Detection Content Ownership: Build, optimise, and govern the organization's detection content library, mapping coverage to adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK. 

Platform Excellence and Tuning: Drive performance optimisation related to detection mechanisms and platform queries; balance sensitivity with operational efficiency to increase signal quality and reduce alert fatigue. 

Provide technical oversight to external suppliers and platform vendors. Coordinate with SOC, incident response, and cyber threat analysis teams to validate efficiency and close coverage gaps. 

Proactive Coverage Management: Continuously assess the evolving threat landscape, identify detection gaps, and drive systematic development of new detections to address emerging techniques across technology domains. 

Innovation and Automation: Introduce and scale new detection techniques including behavioural analytics and machine learning approaches; champion detection-as-code, scripting, and orchestration to automate quality and deployment. 

Standards and Quality Frameworks: Define detection engineering standards, development methodologies, and quality controls; ensure repeatability, portability, and maintainability of detection logic. 

Purple Teaming and Validation: Partner with offensive security to emulate adversaries and validate detections; convert lessons learned into stronger coverage and faster time-to-detect. 

Continuous Improvement and Metrics: Establish measurable benchmarks for coverage, fidelity, and time-to-detect; lead tuning and improvement cycles that demonstrably reduce false positives and improve precision. 

Essential Skills/Experience

- Education: Bachelor's degree in information security, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 - Technical expertise: At least five years of experience in detection engineering. Preferably, this is within security operations centres or detection engineering teams. Proven success leading detection initiatives and applying innovative ways at enterprise scale. 
 - Detection engineering fundamentals: Deep expertise in detection logic design, threat modelling, and coverage mapping; extensive experience developing detections across diverse platforms and environments for enterprise-scale operations. 
 - Threat detection frameworks: Comprehensive familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, and detection engineering methodologies; understanding of how adversary techniques manifest across technology domains and how detection logic must be adapted. 
 - Detection platforms and tooling: At least five years of hands-on experience with enterprise detection platforms, including SIEM, EDR, NDR, and cloud-native security services; advanced proficiency in platform-specific query languages, rule formats, and detection logic development. 
 - Threat intelligence integration: Working knowledge of how threat intelligence is consumed and translated into actionable detection logic; understanding of indicator types, threat actor TTPs, and detection prioritisation based on AstraZeneca's threat profile. 
 - Scripting and automation: At least three years of experience using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or similar for detection logic development and automation; experience with detection-as-code practices and version control for detection content. 
 - Detection formats and standards: At least three years of experience with standardised detection formats, including Sigma rules, YARA signatures, and platform-specific query languages; ability to develop portable and maintainable detection logic. 
 - Performance optimisation: Deep understanding of detection tuning, false positive reduction, and query optimisation techniques; proven ability to balance detection accuracy with practical efficiency. 
 - OT/ICS detection considerations: Familiarity with operational technology environments and the unique constraints affecting detection in industrial settings; awareness of safety implications and availability requirements that influence detection approaches. 
 - Purple team collaboration: Experience working with offensive security teams to validate detection efficacy and identify coverage gaps; understanding of how adversary emulation informs detection improvement. 
 - Threat landscape knowledge: Working experience with threat intelligence, adversary TTPs, and attack techniques across cloud, on-premises, and OT environments; familiarity with how threats evolve and detection strategies must adapt. 
 - Global collaboration: Experience working in a global organisation with geographically dispersed teams and collaborators, including matrix working environments; ability to coordinate across time zones and cultural contexts. 
 - Stakeholder engagement: Substantial experience collaborating with security operations teams, incident responders, and threat intelligence analysts to identify, document, and address detection requirements; proven ability to manage relationships and communications with third-party suppliers and vendors. 
 - Problem-solving and innovation: Recognised internally as an expert problem solver for complex detection challenges; track record of designing, shaping, and implementing innovative detection solutions that address emerging threats. 

Desirable Skills/Experience

- Certifications: Relevant security certifications related to detection development are preferred, for example GIAC GCIA, GCDA or GMON, platform-specific certifications, or threat hunting certifications. 
 - Implement innovative detection engineering solutions: Experience adopting new detection techniques, behavioural analytics, and computational intelligence methods; leading training and change management to ensure successful adoption. 

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world. #Cyber

Why AstraZeneca

Here, your craft has purpose. You will work at the intersection of new security technology and a mission to improve patients' lives. You will partner with diverse experts who move quickly and learn from each other. We blend ambition with support, valuing kindness alongside high standards, so you can take intelligent risks, challenge the norm, and see your ideas translated into real-world protection. With access to modern platforms, smart colleagues, and a global network, you will stretch your skills, build transferable experience, and shape how a leading enterprise safeguards its digital future. 

Call To Action

Seize the opportunity to lead enterprise detection engineering at scale and protect what matters-bring your expertise to AstraZeneca and make your next career-defining move today!

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Please contact us to request accommodation.

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. data.title: Lead Manufacturing Process Engineer – AME & Testing
data.description:
Job Description Summary

The Lead Manufacturing Process Engineer - AME & Testing will provide technical leadership for process engineering, New Product Introduction (NPI), manufacturing test equipment, and automation supporting complex medical equipment. This role will lead and support the development, implementation, qualification, and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes and test equipment, with a strong focus on test equipment automation, Special Purpose Machines (SPMs), electromechanical systems, troubleshooting, failure analysis, and operational performance. The engineer will also leverage technologies such as Power BI, AI/ML tools, IoT platforms, advanced analytics, and equipment data to improve testing effectiveness, enable predictive maintenance, and enhance manufacturing efficiency. 

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- Own and lead manufacturing engineering activities for New Product Introductions (NPI) and manufacturing transfers for existing products, collaborating with global and local cross-functional teams including Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain. 
 - Lead and support process engineering activities associated with new product introductions, manufacturing readiness, production ramp-up, and implementation of new manufacturing and testing technologies. 
 - Design, develop, improve, and support manufacturing automation systems, test equipment, Special Purpose Machines (SPMs), fixtures, tooling, and manufacturing aids to enable efficient and reliable production. 
 - Support the transition from legacy testing systems to new testing platforms, software, automation tools, and testing infrastructure. 
 - Develop and support automated test equipment involving electromechanical components and control systems, including servo motors, encoders, ball screws, sensors, electrical and electronic circuits, and related machine control technologies. 
 - Apply knowledge of NI hardware programming and equipment control systems to support automated equipment functions such as motor control, operational sequencing, equipment run-time management, sensor integration, data capture, and automated machine operations. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and structured problem-solving activities to resolve complex medical equipment manufacturing and testing issues. 
 - Conduct root cause investigations and failure analysis to identify technical issues related to equipment, manufacturing processes, test systems, and product performance, and implement sustainable corrective actions. 
 - Own process qualification and validation of manufacturing processes, assembly-line tools, automation systems, and testing equipment to ensure robust and compliant manufacturing operations. 
 - Lead process risk assessments and drive factory, forward production, and field quality improvements through structured problem-solving, failure analysis, and Defects Per Unit (DPU) reduction initiatives. 
 - Champion Lean Manufacturing, automation, digital transformation, AI/ML, IoT, advanced analytics, and plant modernization initiatives in collaboration with central Advanced Manufacturing Engineering teams to improve operational excellence and productivity. 
 - Utilize Power BI and other appropriate data visualization and analytics tools to support equipment performance monitoring, manufacturing reporting, data analysis, and data-driven decision-making. 
 - Support the collection and analysis of manufacturing and equipment data to identify trends, understand equipment behavior, improve testing processes, and identify opportunities for productivity and quality improvement. 
 - Support the development and implementation of predictive maintenance approaches using equipment, sensor, and performance data to identify potential failures and enable a transition from reactive to data-driven maintenance strategies. 
 - Evaluate opportunities to apply AI/ML and advanced analytics to manufacturing and testing processes where these technologies can improve equipment performance, testing effectiveness, product quality, productivity, or engineering decision-making. 
 - Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders on equipment upgrades, new testing infrastructure, manufacturing technology implementation, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Manage engineering change requests and lead the effective implementation of approved changes on the manufacturing floor, including appropriate documentation and process updates. 
 - Support implementation and execution of Quality Management System (QMS) requirements on the manufacturing floor in accordance with applicable medical device regulations and internal quality requirements. 
 - Develop and maintain clear engineering documentation, equipment and process specifications, validation records, technical reports, work instructions, and other manufacturing process documentation. 
 - Provide technical leadership and coaching to Process Engineering team members in automation, process development, test equipment, risk analysis, structured problem-solving, and QMS requirements. 
 - Initially operate as an individual contributor while providing guidance and oversight to contractors and graduate trainees (GTs), with the potential to take on increased team leadership responsibilities as the organization and program grow. 
 - Support and guide small engineering teams, contractors, or trainees to ensure technical activities are executed effectively and aligned with program, quality, and delivery expectations. 
 - Manage multiple engineering priorities and deliver technical solutions on time while maintaining appropriate standards of quality, documentation, and regulatory compliance. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics & Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - Minimum 6+ years of relevant experience in Process Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related core engineering environment. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in manufacturing or process engineering, including manufacturing process development, equipment development, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. 
 - Hands-on experience with test equipment automation and automated manufacturing or testing systems. 
 - Hands-on exposure to Special Purpose Machines (SPMs), including development, implementation, operation, integration, or troubleshooting. 
 - Practical understanding of electromechanical equipment and components, including servo motors, encoders, ball screws, sensors, electrical and electronic circuits, and equipment control systems. 
 - Knowledge or hands-on experience with NI hardware programming, hardware interfaces, or comparable equipment control systems used to integrate hardware and software for automated machine or test functions. 
 - Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and failure analysis capabilities. 
 - Knowledge and practical application of structured problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and data analysis. 
 - Exposure to Power BI, AI tools, IoT platforms, advanced analytics, or similar digital manufacturing technologies. 
 - Understanding of predictive maintenance concepts, equipment data analysis, sensor-based monitoring, and data-driven decision-making. 
 - Experience or working knowledge of manufacturing process and equipment qualification and validation. 
 - Knowledge of Quality Management System (QMS) requirements applicable to regulated manufacturing environments. 
 - Prior experience providing technical guidance or managing a small team, with experience supporting approximately two or more team members, contractors, or trainees. 
 - Strong focus on engineering documentation and the ability to develop clear technical reports, specifications, validation documentation, and manufacturing records. 
 - Ability to manage multiple technical priorities and deliver commitments on time while maintaining quality and compliance requirements. 

Desired Characteristics

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams. 
 - Experience in medical device or medical equipment manufacturing. 
 - Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI), product industrialization, manufacturing transfer, production ramp-up, or similar product introduction programs. 
 - Experience working with complex medical equipment, capital equipment, or other highly engineered electromechanical products. 
 - Knowledge of PCB/electronics-related manufacturing, assembly, and testing. 
 - Experience supporting equipment upgrades or transitioning from legacy manufacturing/test equipment to new automated testing platforms. 
 - Experience applying Power BI or similar visualization tools to manufacturing, equipment, test, or operational data. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML-enabled manufacturing applications, IoT technologies, connected equipment, or advanced manufacturing analytics. 
 - Experience implementing or supporting predictive maintenance solutions using equipment, sensor, or operational data. 
 - Experience with manufacturing data collection, performance monitoring, reporting, and continuous improvement. 
 - Experience leading process risk assessments, manufacturing quality improvements, DPU reduction, and product reliability improvement initiatives. 
 - Experience collaborating with global Advanced Manufacturing Engineering, product engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, graduate trainees, technicians, or contractors and build technical capability within a manufacturing organization. 
 - Ability to adapt to evolving technologies, new manufacturing platforms, and changing program requirements while maintaining a strong focus on execution, quality, and compliance. 

Inclusion and Diversity

GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. 

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership - always with unyielding integrity. 

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you'd expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you'll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

data.title: Senior Release Engineer
data.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 

- Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An Overview Of This Role

We are looking for a Senior Release Engineer to help design, standardize, and operate reliable enterprise application delivery across the Enterprise Technology & AI team. This role will establish scalable CI/CD practices for business-critical platforms such as Salesforce, Zuora and other Business Systems while enabling engineering teams to ship changes safely, quickly, and with clear operational controls. 

The ideal candidate combines strong release engineering and automation skills with practical experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications. You will build and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines, develop reusable scripts and deployment tooling, improve release governance, and partner with application, security, compliance, and business teams across the release lifecycle. Daily use of approved AI-assisted engineering tools, including Claude, Duo Agent Platform or comparable enterprise-approved tools, is a mandatory expectation for DevOps, troubleshooting, documentation, testing, and automation activities. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines for enterprise applications, including validation, testing, packaging, deployment, promotion, rollback, and post-release verification. 
 - Develop reusable automation using scripting languages such as Python to reduce manual release activities and improve repeatability. 
 - Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude or similar tools every day to accelerate pipeline development, scripting, test creation, troubleshooting, documentation, release analysis, and operational automation. 
 - Define and implement CI/CD patterns for platforms such as Salesforce, Zuora, and other Business Systems. 
 - Establish environment and promotion strategies across development, test, staging, and production, including configuration management and deployment sequencing. 
 - Implement quality gates, automated checks, approvals, audit trails, and policy controls appropriate for enterprise application releases. 
 - Partner with application owners and development teams to define branching, versioning, release cadence, and rollback standards. 
 - Improve release observability through deployment dashboards, pipeline metrics, change records, notifications, and operational reporting. 
 - Investigate failed deployments and release issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement durable corrective actions. 
 - Contribute to release calendars, change planning, blackout-period coordination, and risk-based release decision-making. 
 - Build documentation, runbooks, reusable templates, and enablement materials so teams can adopt consistent delivery practices. 
 - Coach engineers and application teams on GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD tools, release automation, trunk/branching strategies, testing, and operational readiness. 
 - Collaborate with security, compliance, architecture, and enterprise application stakeholders to meet control requirements without creating unnecessary delivery friction. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of experience in release engineering, DevOps or a related discipline. 
 - Experience in Release & deployments for enterprise SaaS applications such as Salesforce, Zuora or Business Systems. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and operating GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines in production environments. 
 - Proficiency in at least one scripting language, such as Python, with the ability to write maintainable automation and integrations. 
 - Mandatory hands-on experience using AI-assisted development and automation tools such as Claude or comparable enterprise-approved tools as part of day-to-day DevOps and release engineering work. 
 - Experience with source control, branching and merging strategies, artifact management, automated testing, deployment orchestration, and rollback practices. 
 - Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication patterns, and integration troubleshooting. 
 - Experience managing releases across multiple environments with strong attention to configuration, dependencies, access controls, and auditability. 
 - Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot pipeline failures, deployment issues, integration defects, and environment inconsistencies. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, business, security, compliance, and operations teams. 
 - Enterprise application releases become more predictable, repeatable, and transparent. 
 - Manual deployment effort and avoidable release errors decrease through automation and standardization. 

About The Team

ETA teams adopt reusable GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD patterns for Salesforce, Zuora, and other enterprise platforms. Release quality improves through automated validation, testing, policy checks, and post-deployment verification. Deployment, change, and compliance evidence is available through reliable pipeline records and operational reporting. Application teams can move faster while maintaining appropriate controls for business-critical systems. AI-assisted DevOps adoption measurably improves engineering throughput, troubleshooting speed, automation coverage, and documentation quality without reducing delivery controls. 

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
 - Flexible Paid Time Off 
 - Team Member Resource Groups
 - Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
 - Growth and Development Fund
 - Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. 

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. 

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us. 

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab's policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We're committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. 

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care-about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. 

Could that be you?

About The Role

Join the Vertical Solutions team and build UiPath's most ambitious product - an AI agentic orchestration platform that's been recognized as our Invention of the Year for two consecutive years. As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of our Act 2 strategy, building the infrastructure that allows enterprises to seamlessly orchestrate AI agents, robots, and human-in-the-loop workflows to achieve critical business outcomes. 

You'll be working with Lax and the Maestro backend team to build the core orchestration engine that powers enterprise AI automation. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role on UiPath's biggest strategic bet. 

What You'll Do

- Build and Scale: Design, develop, and maintain full stack for Vertical Solutions products leveraging AI Coding Assistants. 
 - Hands-On Development: Write production-quality code daily, leveraging AI tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot, etc. ) to enhance your development workflow
 - Prototype and Ship: Take ideas from Prototype to validate with real customers and turn the ones that prove value into production systems. 
 - Measure what matters: Design evaluations, measure quality against real customer data, and understand when metrics mislead. Our systems are often non-deterministic. Responsible shipping means measuring honestly, not chasing vanity numbers. 
 - Customer-Centric Engineering: Deeply understand who will use the features you build and why they need them, translating customer needs into elegant technical solutions
 - Ensure Reliability: Contribute to building highly scalable, reliable distributed systems that enterprises depend on. 

What We're Looking For

- Builder mindset - you enjoy turning ideas into working systems and taking ownership from Concept through, Customer impact and Production
 - Strong full stack knowledge including frontend systems like React and backend systems -Python and/or C# - most Vertical Solutions product development is Python (agents, APIs, ETL), while core platform work includes C#, frontend in React. Willingness to work across both is important. 
 - Experience building production AI systems - LLMs, tool-calling, multi-agent architectures, orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent), structured outputs, orchestration, and evaluation of model behavior in real-world workflows
 - Distributed systems experience - designing resilient systems with idempotency, replay ability, state management, and long-running jobs
 - Strong analytical thinking - able to reason quantitatively about system quality and make sound decisions using imperfect signals
 - Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid prototyping - able to move from idea to proof-of-concept quickly and iterate based on customer feedback. 
 - Experience with healthcare Tech/ Finance Tech/ Procurement Tech systems experience will be a big plus. 

What You'll Bring To The Team

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent experience. 
 - 7+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on distributed systems and backend architecture. 
 - Strong proficiency in one or more system-level languages - Javascript / C# / Java etc
 - Full-stack experience: ability to work across backend services and frontend layers (REST/GraphQL APIs, basic UI integration, component contracts). 
 - Deep understanding of object-oriented programming, architectural design patterns, system design, and data structures & algorithms. 
 - Experience with React, TypeScript, or other modern frontend frameworks for deeper full-stack contribution. 
 - Strong grasp of multithreading, asynchronous programming, synchronization, and cloud-native programming models. 
 - Hands-on experience with cloud ecosystems: Azure, AWS, or GCP. 
 - Proficiency with containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI coding tools and coding agents (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) and a demonstrated ability to integrate these into daily engineering workflows. 
 - Experience driving team adoption of AI-powered productivity tools - setting norms, measuring impact, and iterating on usage patterns. 
 - Familiarity with modern engineering practices: agile development, CI/CD, DevOps, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills; proven success collaborating with globally distributed teams and managing complex, time-bound deliverables. 
 - Ability to understand, communicate, and drive complex technical decisions with stakeholders at all levels. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with healthcare Tech/ Finance Tech/ Procurement Tech systems experience will be a big plus. 
 - Data science and evaluation
 - Experience with applied ML techniques such as classification, anomaly detection, ranking, or predictive modeling
 - Experience evaluating AI systems using experimentation, metrics, and empirical analysis to improve quality and reliability
 - Data and retrieval systems
 - Experience with large-scale data platforms (Snowflake, columnar warehouses, denormalized data models)
 - Familiarity with retrieval-heavy architectures, RAG systems, or citation-grounded AI workflows
 - Engineering for trustworthy AI
 - Experience blending deterministic and probabilistic systems (rules engines + AI)
 - Experience designing eval-driven systems, regression testing for LLM outputs, or human-in-the-loop review workflows
 - Platform and product development
 - Frontend familiarity (React, TypeScript)
 - Workflow orchestration platforms (Temporal, Airflow, Maestro, BPMN, Step Functions)
 - Kubernetes and distributed infrastructure
 - Experience in startups, applied research, or 0→1 product environments
 - Open-source contributions

How We Work

Vertical Solutions operates like an internal startup inside UiPath: small teams, fast iteration, and real customers in the loop. We build quickly, test ideas with users, and turn the best ones into products. Some ideas won't make it - that's expected. You'll work in short cycles, demo frequently, and adapt as we learn. We care more about solving the right problem than protecting a plan that no longer fits. If you enjoy ambiguity, rapid feedback, and building where product boundaries move fast, you'll likely thrive here. 

Why Join Us

- Work on cutting-edge AI technology that's shaping the future of enterprise automation
 - Be part of a team building Times top 100 Invention of the Year (2 years running)
 - Collaborate with talented engineers who value rapid iteration and customer impact
 - Contribute to UiPath's Act 2 strategy - our most important product initiative

Maybe you don't tick all the boxes above-but still think you'd be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes-and passion can't be learned. 

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected. 

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

data.title: Senior Business Automation Engineer
data.description:
We're Hiring: Full or Part-Time Automation Engineer

Location: Remote

Hours: 30 hours per week, with overlap during UK working hours

Contract: 4 months initially, with the option to extend

About NS Accounting

NS Accounting is a growing UK accounting practice supporting around 1, 400 clients. 

We're focused on using technology and automation to make accounting operations more efficient. Our current stack includes Capium, Karbon, Xero, Zoho Sign and n8n, and we're building automations across tax filings, administration, data pipelines and internal workflows. 

We're looking for a Full or Part-Time Automation Engineer who enjoys solving real operational problems and building reliable, production-ready automation. 

What You'll Do

• Build browser automations using Playwright and develop API integrations to automate filings and administrative processes across our accounting platforms. 

• Analyse how web applications work behind the scenes including network requests, internal APIs and HAR files to create reliable automations rather than relying solely on UI interactions. 

• Build, maintain and improve n8n workflows. 

• Maintain ETL pipelines that move operational data into our data warehouse. 

• Build reverse ETL processes to sync warehouse data back into business systems such as Karbon. 

• Write tests, create pull requests and clearly document the systems and automations you build. 

• Design reliable integrations end-to-end, including data flows, error handling, safeguards and monitoring. 

What We're Looking For

Essential experience: 

• TypeScript or Node. js

• Playwright or Puppeteer

• REST APIs and webhooks

• n8n or similar workflow automation platforms

• Git and GitHub

• Automating web applications through internal APIs, not simply clicking through screens

• ETL pipelines and databases we currently use PyAirbyte, dbt and PostgreSQL

• Reverse ETL and syncing warehouse data back into operational/business tools

• Designing reliable integrations and production automation

Because these systems can make real tax filings and update live client data, attention to detail is essential. You should be comfortable testing thoroughly, implementing safeguards and documenting your work. 

Nice to Have

Experience or knowledge of UK accounting and tax processes, including: 

• Self Assessment

• Corporation Tax

• VAT

• Making Tax Digital (MTD)

• Companies House

How We Work

We're a small, practical team with quick decision-making. You'll work closely with the business owner, who reviews and approves every change before it goes into production. 

This role would suit someone who enjoys automation, system integration and solving complex workflow problems, and who wants their work to have a direct impact on a growing accounting practice. 

Interested? Apply through LinkedIn or get in touch with us to discuss the role.

data.description:
Agentic Full-Stack Engineer

About Securin

Securin is an AI-native cybersecurity company. Our Preemptive Exposure Management Platform turns exposure data into clear decisions - giving organizations the confidence to know which risks are exploitable, what to fix first, and how to act before attackers do. 

Our Engineering Values

We build with agents and verify with humans - treating AI as a genuine collaborator, holding agent-generated code to the same review standard as human-authored code, and shipping features only when test coverage and security checks are in place. We take end-to-end ownership, write maintainable code, and bring security awareness into every decision - not as a checkbox, but as a core discipline. 

The Role

A high-agency software engineer who uses coding agents as a force multiplier: generating design specs with AI, curating those outputs with engineering judgment, and shipping high-quality features at pace on the Securin cybersecurity platform. 

Responsibilities

● Feature Development

Design and ship full-stack features for the Securin platform end-to-end - using AI coding agents (Claude) to generate specs and boilerplate, then curating those outputs with engineering rigor, security context, and architectural judgment before finalizing. Work with teams in the US and India to facilitate communication, operations, and design. Required to attend 1-2 US evening meetings a week to sync with India based teams. 

● Agent & Automation Engineering

Build agentic workflows and automation pipelines that streamline engineering - and enforce a human-in-the-loop review process ensuring every AI-produced change is critically evaluated for correctness, security, and fit before it reaches production. 

● Platform & Infrastructure

Architect and maintain cloud-native SaaS services on AWS, contributing to API design, data modeling, and microservices architecture that power real-time threat intelligence ingestion and delivery. 

● Security Mindset

Apply secure-by-design principles throughout development and work alongside Securin's security researchers to translate vulnerability intelligence domain knowledge into robust platform capabilities. 

Requirements

● 3+ years building production SaaS

● Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

● Public cloud experience required (AWS preferred, GCP or Azure acceptable)

● Deep familiarity with: 

○ Containerization

○ Serverless architecture

○ Event-driven architecture

○ RESTful API design

Culture-Forward Building with AI: What We Expect - Role-Specific

○ Hands-on, daily use of AI coding agents is a prerequisite. 

○ Must be able to critically review agent-generated code and specs for: 

● Hallucinations

● Security flaws

● Architectural drift before merging. 

General

Securin is committed to becoming an AI-native organization where GenAI is embedded into how every team works - not just as an occasional assistant, but as a core part of delivery, operations, and how our expertise compounds over time. We expect every employee to actively integrate

GenAI tools into daily workflows - Automating routine tasks, accelerating research and analysis, drafting documents, and building reusable AI-powered processes for their function. You should understand the limitations of GenAI (including inaccuracies and data sensitivity boundaries), follow data classification rules, and continuously improve your AI proficiency. As you grow, we expect you to move beyond using GenAI to building with it - designing agent workflows, contributing reusable skills, and helping Securin compound its Proactive Exposure Management expertise faster than any competitor can replicate. 

● Demonstrated ability to use GenAI tools (e. g. , Claude, ChatGPT, etc. ) for daily work - drafting, research, summarization, data analysis, code generation, or workflow automation as relevant to the role. 

● Working knowledge of GenAI limitations including hallucination risk, context window constraints, and data sensitivity boundaries; ability to validate AI-generated output before acting on it. 

● Familiarity with prompt engineering techniques - structuring multi-step instructions, providing context, and iterating on output quality to achieve production-grade results. 

● Comfort with agentic AI workflows - using, designing, or building multi-step AI agents that execute tasks autonomously with human-in-the-loop validation. 

● Awareness of AI security fundamentals - prompt injection risks, data classification rules, sandboxed execution, and responsible handling of sensitive data in AI workflows. 

● Familiarity with connecting GenAI tools to internal data sources, APIs, and enterprise systems. 

● Ability to contribute reusable AI skills, templates, agent configurations, or automation workflows to a shared repository for team-wide use. 

● Willingness to learn and adopt new AI tools as they evolve; participation in AI adoption sprints, hackathons, and knowledge-sharing within the team. 

Location : Remote (For candidates outside Chennai), Hybrid model (2 days a week to office - for candidates from Chennai)

data.title: Senior Software Engineer I
data.description:
Job Description

The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company's growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company's technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company. 

Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues. 

The Technology organization enables and accelerates the company's growth strategies, delivering global capabilities and services in support of Amex's customers and colleagues, while maintaining 24/7 servicing and availability to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality customer experience. Technology provides the foundation for everything we do in the company while driving differentiation through building and leveraging innovative technology and data insights. 

The Global Merchant and Network Services Technology (GMNST) organization at American Express is responsible for modernizing the payments network to enable next-generation payments products. The team creates flexible merchant platforms to acquire, bill, pay, service and foster innovation, while enabling a payments ecosystem to connect and authenticate parties seamlessly and securely

As a Software Quality Engineer, you will join our Global Merchant and Network Services Technology team that has embarked on building a highly available and scalable distributed systems on the cloud to support the company's long-term strategy and vision. Your primary role includes driving execution across multiple Scrum teams, ensuring product backlog priorities are clearly defined, aligned to stakeholder needs, and delivered with high quality. 

Key Initiatives

- Card Network Authorizations/Routing, Clearing and Settlement. 
 - ATM, Debit, Credit and Push Payment Transactions. 
 - Platform Engineering and Foundational Capabilities of distributed systems 
 - High Availability, Resiliency and Performance Engineering on Cloud

Responsibilities

- Define and drive the quality engineering strategy, architecture, standards, and roadmap for large-scale, distributed, mission-critical payment platforms. 
 - Provide technical leadership across multiple engineering teams, influencing architecture, solution design, development practices, testing strategies, and production readiness. 
 - Architect, design, and develop scalable automation frameworks, platforms, tooling, and reusable quality engineering capabilities supporting functional, API, integration, system, regression, end-to-end, resiliency, and performance testing. 
 - Remain hands-on with engineering by developing automation solutions, reviewing code, creating proof-of-concepts, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and solving systemic quality challenges. 
 - Partner with architects and senior engineers during architecture and design reviews to identify quality, scalability, reliability, testability, and operational risks early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Establish and champion shift-left, continuous testing, testability, and quality-by-design principles throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Define enterprise-grade testing approaches for distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, transactional platforms, and complex system integrations. 
 - Develop strategies for validating high-volume financial transactions, including authorization, routing, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, and data integrity across distributed systems. 
 - Lead quality engineering efforts for high availability, resiliency, failover, disaster recovery, scalability, and performance of mission-critical platforms. 
 - Establish automated quality gates and integrate comprehensive testing capabilities into CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable and frequent software delivery. 
 - Define and evolve quality metrics, engineering scorecards, test coverage models, observability strategies, release readiness criteria, and production quality indicators. 
 - Leverage production telemetry, monitoring, logging, and observability capabilities to proactively identify quality risks and improve system reliability. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis of complex production and pre-production issues spanning application, infrastructure, cloud, database, messaging, and integration layers. 
 - Identify systemic engineering and quality gaps and drive long-term solutions rather than point-in-time fixes. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies, open-source frameworks, AI-assisted engineering capabilities, and industry practices to continuously evolve the organization's quality engineering capabilities. 
 - Collaborate with engineering, product management, architecture, DevOps/SRE, security, and operations teams to ensure successful delivery of highly scalable and resilient platforms. 
 - Provide technical mentorship and guidance to Quality Engineers and Software Engineers, raising engineering standards and strengthening quality engineering capabilities across teams. 
 - Influence engineering leaders and stakeholders across organizational boundaries and drive alignment on quality priorities, technical investments, risks, and remediation strategies. 
 - Lead quality engineering for complex, cross-functional initiatives involving globally distributed engineering teams and multiple dependent platforms. 
 - Champion a culture where quality, reliability, performance, and operational excellence are shared engineering responsibilities. 

Qualifications

- 10+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, Software Development in Test (SDET), Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or related engineering disciplines, including significant experience providing technical leadership for complex software platforms. 
 - 5+ years of experience in Payments, Banking, FinTech, Financial Services, Card Networks, or other high-volume transactional environments strongly preferred. 
 - Deep understanding of payment processing concepts such as authorization, routing, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, ATM, debit, credit, and push-payment processing is highly desirable. 
 - Advanced programming skills in Java, Python, or comparable object-oriented programming languages, with demonstrated experience building production-quality automation frameworks, engineering tools, or test platforms. 
 - Proven experience architecting and implementing scalable automation frameworks and reusable testing capabilities for APIs, microservices, distributed systems, integration, and end-to-end workflows. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with API and service testing technologies such as Rest Assured, Karate, Postman, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture, including microservices, asynchronous/event-driven processing, messaging, APIs, databases, caching, and service-to-service integrations. 
 - Strong SQL and data engineering/testing skills, with demonstrated experience validating complex transactional workflows and high-volume financial datasets. 
 - Extensive experience designing automated testing strategies and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines using modern DevOps and software delivery practices. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures and experience validating applications deployed on public or private cloud platforms. 
 - Demonstrated experience with reliability, resiliency, scalability, performance, failover, disaster recovery, and high-availability testing for mission-critical systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with monitoring, logging, tracing, and observability platforms such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Grafana, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience supporting and troubleshooting high-volume, business-critical production systems with stringent availability and reliability requirements. 
 - Demonstrated ability to assess complex architectures, identify systemic quality and operational risks, and influence engineering teams toward effective technical solutions. 
 - Proven track record of leading quality engineering initiatives spanning multiple teams, platforms, and organizational boundaries. 
 - Strong understanding of Agile engineering practices and experience delivering large, complex, cross-functional technology initiatives. 
 - Exceptional analytical, debugging, problem-solving, and root cause analysis capabilities, with the ability to navigate complex distributed-system failures. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, establish engineering standards, influence technical direction, and drive organizational adoption of quality engineering best practices. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts and risks effectively to engineers, architects, product leaders, and senior technology stakeholders. 
 - Strong ownership mindset with a passion for engineering excellence, automation, operational reliability, continuous improvement, and customer-centric delivery. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline preferred. 

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service. 

As part of Team Amex, you'll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express. 

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally: 

- Competitive base salaries
 - Bonus incentives
 - Support for financial-well-being and retirement
 - Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
 - Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
 - Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
 - Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
 - Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
 - Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law. 

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

data.title: Senior Project Engineer
data.description:
ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient. 

Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most-prized resource. If you share that passion - and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations - we invite you to join us!

ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

Job Title: Senior Project Engineer

Location: Mumbai

Employment Type: full-time

The job

In this role, you will be responsible for power system modeling, engineering analysis, real-time power system applications, ADMS/OMS, power automation, project engineering, testing, and commissioning. You will develop and validate electrical network models, perform static and dynamic power system studies, configure real-time applications using field data, and support integration with SCADA, DCS, IEDs, gateways, and external systems. 

The role also involves preparing technical and project documentation, coordinating with customers and multidisciplinary teams, leading or supporting FAT and SAT activities, troubleshooting system and communication issues, demonstrating application functionalities, and conducting customer training. 

Key Responsibilities

Develop, validate, maintain, and update electrical network models and digital twins using ETAP or equivalent power system analysis platforms. 

- Perform power system studies including Load Flow, Short-Circuit, Protection/Relay Coordination, Harmonic Analysis, Transient Stability, Motor Acceleration, Voltage Stability, Arc Flash, and related studies. 
 - Review SLDs, equipment data, protection settings, network parameters, and operating philosophies; analyze study results and prepare engineering reports with recommendations. 
 - Configure and commission real-time power system applications using live field measurements, equipment status, and operational data. 
 - Configure and validate State & Load Estimation (SLE), network topology processing, observability, bad-data handling, and online power system analysis. 
 - Map and validate analog, digital, status, command, and calculated signals from SCADA/DCS/IED/gateway systems and troubleshoot model/data mismatches. 
 - Model and analyze distribution networks and configure ADMS functions including distribution load flow, state estimation, FLISR, switching analysis, Voltage/VAR Optimization (VVO), and network reconfiguration. 
 - Support Outage Management System (OMS) configuration, network tracing, outage identification, restoration workflows, and integration with SCADA, GIS, and enterprise systems. 
 - Engineer and configure power automation and SCADA interfaces, including points/tags, alarms, events, trends, measurements, statuses, commands, and HMI functions. 
 - Configure and troubleshoot communication using protocols such as IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3, Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC UA/DA, and ICCP/TASE. 2. 
 - Support integration of IEDs, RTUs, PLCs, gateways, managed switches, and control-center interfaces. 
 - Perform basic IT/OT system and network configuration, including servers/workstations, IP addressing, managed switches, VLANs, remote access, redundancy, and connectivity troubleshooting. 
 - Prepare FAT/SAT procedures and lead or participate in internal testing, FAT, integration testing, site commissioning, SAT, and functional demonstrations. 
 - Investigate technical issues, perform root-cause analysis, close test observations and punch points, and support customer acceptance. 
 - Plan and monitor project engineering activities, schedules, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and technical interfaces. 
 - Prepare and review FDS, architecture documents, signal lists, interface documents, study reports, test procedures, commissioning records, user manuals, and as-built documentation. 
 - Coordinate with project management, engineering teams, software teams, vendors, EPC contractors, consultants, and customers. 
 - Prepare and deliver customer training covering system architecture, power system applications, operational workflows, troubleshooting, and routine system operation. 
 - Support technical knowledge transfer and mentor junior engineers where required. 

Essential Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related discipline. 

- Minimum 5-6 years of relevant experience in power system studies, real-time power system applications, ADMS/SCADA, power automation, or related project engineering. 
 - Hands-on experience in electrical network modeling and power system analysis. 
 - Working knowledge of real-time power system applications, SCADA, communication protocols, and IT/OT environments. 
 - Experience in FAT, SAT, testing, commissioning, technical documentation, and customer interaction. 
 - Industry exposure in Oil & Gas, Industrial, Utilities / Transmission & Distribution, or Power Generation; Renewable/BESS experience is an advantage. 
 - Professional written and spoken English. 
 - Willingness to travel and mobilize to project sites within the GCC, including onshore/offshore locations and extended site stays when required. 

Desired Skills

Power System Modeling & Digital Twin Development

- Load Flow, Short-Circuit & Relay Coordination
 - Harmonic & Transient Stability Analysis
 - Motor Acceleration & Voltage Stability Studies
 - ETAP Power System Analysis
 - Real-Time Power System Analysis & SLE
 - ADMS / OMS / FLISR / VVO
 - SCADA Configuration & Integration
 - IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3, Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC UA/DA & ICCP/TASE. 2
 - Industrial Communication & IT/OT Networking
 - FAT, SAT & Site Commissioning
 - Technical Documentation & Report Preparation
 - Project Engineering & Coordination
 - Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis
 - Customer Training & Technical Demonstration
 - Leadership, Communication & Stakeholder Management
 - Knowledge of PSS®E, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSCAD, CYME, ASPEN OneLiner, Hitachi Energy/ABB Network Manager, or equivalent platforms is advantageous. 

ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria. 

ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. 

Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.

In addition to being a major independent power producer in India, ReNew is evolving to become an end-to-end decarbonization partner providing solutions in a just and inclusive manner in the areas of clean energy, green hydrogen, value-added energy offerings through digitalisation, storage, and carbon markets that increasingly are integral to addressing climate change. With a total capacity of more than 13. 4 GW (including projects in pipeline), ReNew's solar and wind energy projects are spread across 150+ sites, with a presence spanning 18 states in India, contributing to 1. 9 % of India's power capacity. In the over 10 years of its operation, ReNew has generated almost 1. 3 lakh jobs, directly and indirectly. ReNew has achieved market leadership in the Indian renewable energy industry against the backdrop of the Government of India's policies to promote growth of this sector. ReNew's current group of stockholders contains several marquee investors including CPP Investments, Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, Goldman Sachs, GEF SACEF and JERA. Its mission is to play a pivotal role in meeting India's growing energy needs in an efficient, sustainable, and socially responsible manner. data.title: Senior Quality Assurance Quality Control Engineer
data.description:
Company Description Bhavi Plast Pvt Ltd is a long-established engineering company that designs, builds, and commissions corrosion-resistant equipment for process plants across India and internationally. The company specializes in wet scrubbing systems, dust collection systems, high-efficiency blowers, ducting, exhaust systems, and a wide range of FRP and dual-laminate chemical storage and process tanks. All systems are process-simulated, engineered to international standards such as BS EN 13121 and ASME Section X RTP-1, and tested in-house at its Mankoli, Bhiwandi plant before shipment. Bhavi Plast is registered and technically vetted by major engineering consultants, with equipment operating in more than ten countries. The team frequently develops custom solutions based on client gas analysis and site constraints, providing sized proposals and performance curves for demanding applications. 

Role Description: The Senior Quality Assurance Quality Control Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Mankoli, Bhiwandi. This role is responsible for establishing, implementing, and improving QA/QC processes for FRP, dual-laminate, and thermoplastic equipment, ensuring compliance with relevant engineering and safety standards. Day-to-day tasks include preparing and executing inspection and test plans, supervising in-process and final inspections, monitoring material quality, and maintaining detailed quality records and reports. The engineer will lead internal quality audits, support external client and third-party inspections, investigate nonconformities, and drive root cause analysis and corrective actions. The role also involves collaborating with design, production, and commissioning teams to resolve quality issues, support continuous improvement, and mentor junior quality personnel. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Inspect incoming raw materials (FRP resins, PP/HDPE sheets, steel, motors, blowers, pumps, gaskets, fasteners) against approved specifications, and accept, hold or reject them

- Monitor in-process fabrication, welding, lamination, lining and assembly, checking dimensions, thickness, joints and finish against approved drawings

- Catch defects at the stage they occur to reduce rework and rejection

- Conduct stage-wise and final inspection, and release equipment for dispatch only when all checks and documentation are complete

- Prepare and maintain Inspection Reports (IR), Non-Conformance Reports (NCR), calibration records, test certificates and the client quality dossier / data book

- Coordinate with production, vendors, clients, consultants and third-party inspectors, and act as the plant's point of contact for inspections and customer audits

- Handle client complaints promptly and professionally

- Ensure adherence to ISO 9001, client specifications and statutory requirements, and keep SOPs and checklists current

- Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and track and reduce rework, rejection and wastage

- Maintain calibration of measuring instruments and train shop-floor teams on SOPs and inspection methods

- Report quality metrics to management regularly

Qualifications: 

Must-have: 

- Diploma / B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Chemical or Production Engineering

- 4-8 years of QA/QC experience in fabrication, FRP / PP / HDPE equipment manufacturing or the EPC industry

- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications

- Hands-on experience with inspection methods, measuring instruments and quality documentation (IR, NCR, test certificates)

- Working knowledge of ISO 9001 and customer audit requirements

Preferred: 

- Experience in air pollution control equipment, ducting, chimneys, scrubbers, blowers, tanks or chemical process equipment

- Additional certification in Quality Management, ISO 9001 or NDT

- Experience handling client and third-party inspections

- Experience with RCA and CAPA tools

- Some experience guiding or training a small team of inspectors or shop-floor staff

Attributes we care about most: 

- High ownership: treats the quality of every dispatched item as personally their responsibility

- Ability to work independently: doesn't need to be chased, and can run inspections and documentation end to end

- Integrity and the courage to say no: holds the line on quality even when deadlines or production pressure push back

- Attention to detail: notices the small defect or missing record that others overlook

- Proactive, not reactive: prevents problems through checks and root cause fixes instead of only reporting them afterwards

- Clear communicator: able to explain defects, standards and corrective actions to the shop floor, vendors and customers alike

- Process-minded and well organised: keeps records so tidy that any order can be traced and defended

- Team player with a teaching mindset: builds quality awareness in the people around them

What We Offer: 

- Real ownership of quality in a company with a track record going back to 1977, and direct visibility to management
 - Varied, technically meaningful work across FRP, PP, HDPE and MS-FRP lined equipment for many industries
 - A stable, collaborative work culture with room to grow into a quality leadership role
 - Scope to improve systems, build better processes and see the impact of your work
 - The chance to contribute to cleaner air and safer industrial operations

Work Schedule: 

Day shift: 9: 15 AM to 6: 30 PM

Monday to Saturday

Occasional extended hours during project deadlines

Company Description

CashFlo is an AI-driven fintech company transforming how businesses manage payments, accounting, and financial workflows. Backed by Elevation Capital and General Catalyst, CashFlo operates at the intersection of Payments, Lending, and SaaS, processing over ₹20, 000 crore in invoices every month across 300, 000 MSMEs and 1, 200+ corporates, with 30+ lending partners.
