data.title: Principal Data Platform Engineer
data.description:
Overview

Are you passionate about data platforms and tools? Are you an open-minded, structured thinker who is passionate about building systems at scale. Do you understand data platforms, know how to build them and want to help our users to make data actionable? If so, this role with our team at Atlassian is for you. 

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Data Platform Team to build a world class data platform that powers crucial business decisions throughout the organization. 

You will partner with analytics teams, data engineers and data scientists across various initiatives and work with them to understand the gaps and bring your findings back to the team to build these capabilities. 

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. 

Responsibilities

We build analytical data platforms for Atlassian that serve both Engineering and Data Engineering to help them generate valuable insights from data. 

As a Principal Engineer On This Team You Will

- Own the long term architecture and technical direction for core platform capabilities and be accountable for their reliability, cost efficiency and adoption
 - Design and build foundational platform components that other engineering teams build on top of, across areas like ingestion, transformation, orchestration, compute and consumption
 - Architect robust multi-tenant platform standards by establishing clear cross-layer contracts, tenant isolation, and SLOs to enable autonomous producers and consumers, while driving compute and storage efficiency across workloads
 - Lead cross team technical initiatives and architecture reviews, influence platform strategy with senior stakeholders and act as a technical mentor and multiplier for Senior engineers
 - Stay hands on. You will be in the code on the hardest problems, not just reviewing designs

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range. 

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity. 

Qualifications

Required

- 12+ years of software or data engineering experience, with at least 6 years building data platform infrastructure
 - You have built a data platform or a significant component of one and operated it in production. For example an ingestion framework, a transformation framework, a compute or query layer, an orchestration layer, a metadata or lineage service or a data quality framework
 - You can describe the scale that component ran at in concrete numbers. Data volume, ingest throughput, number of pipelines or jobs, query concurrency and latency, number of onboarded teams or tenants and infrastructure cost. 
 - Deep understanding of big data and distributed systems challenges including partitioning, shuffle behaviour, skew, idempotency and backfills
 - Experience designing both batch and streaming architectures and clear judgement on when each is the right answer
 - Expert level programming skills in language such as Java, Kotlin or Python and built solutions on public cloud offerings such as Amazon Web Services
 - Experience with big data processing and storage technologies such as Spark, DBT and with open table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake
 - A track record of owning ambiguous cross team problems end to end and of influencing without authority
 - Degree in Computer Science, EE or a related STEM discipline or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have

- Experience with high performance analytical or MPP databases such as StarRocks, Druid, ClickHouse or Pinot
 - Experience with change data capture and event driven ingestion at high volume
 - Experience building a semantic layer or metrics store and governing shared metric definitions
 - Experience with the data foundations of ML platforms, such as point-in-time correct training data, online and offline feature parity or backfilling features at scale
 - Experience with data governance, access control, lineage and compliance, including regulated environments such as FedRAMP
 - Experience running platform components on Kubernetes
 - Experience with multi region data architectures, including replication, failover and consistency tradeoffs

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go. atlassian. com/perksandbenefits . 

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. 

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them. 

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go. atlassian. com/crh .

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer I
data.description:
For over four decades, PAR Technology Corporation (NYSE: PAR) has been a leader in restaurant technology, empowering brands worldwide to create lasting connections with their guests. Our innovative solutions and commitment to excellence provide comprehensive software and hardware that enable seamless experiences and drive growth for over 100, 000 restaurants in more than 110 countries. Embracing our "Better Together" ethos, we offer Unified Customer Experience solutions, combining point-of-sale, digital ordering, loyalty and back-office software solutions as well as industry-leading hardware and drive-thru offerings. To learn more, visit partech. com or connect with us on LinkedIn, X (formerly Twitter), Facebook, and Instagram. 

Position Description

As a Site Reliability Engineer I, you will be part of the global Cloud Centre of Excellence organization responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence of PAR's cloud platforms and SaaS services. 

This role combines cloud infrastructure, observability, and automation to support highly available and resilient systems, with growing use of AI-assisted tooling in day-to-day operations. You will work closely with Engineering, Security, and Product teams to improve service reliability, automate operational processes, reduce operational toil, and enhance customer experience. 

The ideal candidate has a solid, hands-on foundation in cloud operations and is comfortable owning production issues end-to-end, while continuing to build toward modern SRE practices and Infrastructure as Code. 

Position Location: India - Gurugram or Jaipur (Hybrid)

This role supports 24x7 operations across multiple regions. Working days and hours are structured on a rotational basis to provide coverage and the role may also include on-call/after-hours support as needed. 

What We Are Looking For

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
 - 3+ years of experience supporting cloud-native applications and infrastructure in AWS and GCP pr Azure environments
 - Experience supporting production applications in a highly available environment (SaaS environment a plus)
 - Hands-on experience with Linux systems administration and exposure to Windows systems administration
 - Experience with at least one observability/monitoring platform such as Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Prometheus. 
 - Experience with scripting/automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, NodeJS, or similar languages
 - Working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes-based platforms
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code concepts and tools such as Terraform
 - Experience with RDS, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or other managed cloud database services
 - Working understanding of cloud networking, DNS, load balancing, and application performance troubleshooting
 - Experienced in an incident management processes and root cause analysis methodologies
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices
 - Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 - Ability to write clear documentation - runbooks, operational procedures, postmortems, and knowledge articles. 

Additional Skills

- AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Solutions Architect Associate or DevOps Engineer certification
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development or operational tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q Developer, AWS Bedrock, or similar)
 - Exposure to building AI agents or intelligent operational assistants
 - Experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar delivery platforms
 - Familiarity with AIOps, anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, or intelligent alerting concepts
 - Awareness of Platform Engineering concepts and Internal Developer Platforms (IDP)
 - Exposure to highly regulated or large-scale SaaS environments

Unleash your potential: What you will be doing and owning: 

- Monitor and support the reliability, performance, and scalability of PAR's cloud platforms and SaaS services
 - Help build and maintain monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and observability solutions
 - Support tracking of Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and reliability metrics
 - Participate in incident response, troubleshooting, escalation, and service restoration activities
 - Contribute to root cause analysis and blameless postmortems that drive continuous improvement
 - Develop and maintain automation scripts to reduce manual effort and eliminate operational toil, using AI-assisted tools where useful
 - Help identify monitoring and observability gaps through data analysis
 - Assist in creating and maintaining runbooks, operational procedures, and troubleshooting workflows
 - Support Kubernetes platform operations and containerized application deployments
 - Assist with Infrastructure as Code initiatives using Terraform and related tooling
 - Collaborate with Engineering teams to improve application reliability and operational readiness
 - Participate in change management reviews and production readiness assessments
 - Help analyse system trends, performance metrics, and operational data to identify improvements
 - Support capacity planning, performance optimization, and disaster recovery activities
 - Partner with Security teams on vulnerability remediation and operational compliance activities
 - Participate in rotational shift coverage and on-call support for critical production systems

Interview Process

Interview #2: Video interview with the Hiring Manager (via MS Teams)

Interview #3: Video interview with the Team (via MS Teams)

- About the Role

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll do meaningful work that makes a positive global impact. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. With industry-leading R&D investment, we empower our teams to solve complex scientific challenges-from environmental protection to advancing healthcare and cancer research. 

As a Staff Engineer, AI Solutions & Platforms, you will provide end-to-end architectural, design, and technical leadership across multiple teams delivering enterprise-grade AI and Generative AI solutions. As a hands-on technical leader and architect, you will own system design decisions, define reference architectures, and guide implementation of AI-powered capabilities, including deep learning models, LLMs, RAG solutions and agentic workflows across internal and external customer-facing applications. You'll also mentor engineers, influence platform strategy, and ensure AI-driven systems are secure, resilient and production-ready. A successful candidate in this role is expected to collaborate effectively with the broader teams, and consistently deliver well-architected, scalable, secure, production-grade AI and Generative AI features supporting a variety of use cases and scientific products, with measurable impact on scientific workflows, customer outcomes and innovation velocity. 

Key Responsibilities

- Provide software and systems architecture leadership including reference architectures, design standards, patterns, and best practices for AI and Generative AI platforms and solutions. 
 - Own high-level and low-level system design, including component architecture, data flows, integration patterns, and deployment strategies. 
 - Design and evolve cloud-native, event-driven, and API-first architectures for AI-enabled products and platforms. 
 - Design, develop, and integrate Generative AI systems using LangChain and LangGraph for agentic workflows and orchestration. 
 - Architect and implement agentic AI and RAG workflows, including data ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, tool calling, memory, and prompt engineering. 
 - Build and deploy LLM-powered services using Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and OpenAI-compatible APIs. 
 - Leverage Ollama for local and on-prem LLM system experimentation and evaluation.

data.description:
AI Engineering & Data Science Lead

Company: Tapza Technologies

Location: Hyderabad, India

Employment: Full-time | On-site

Experience: 5+ years, with demonstrated ownership of production AI systems

About Tapza

At Tapza, we're building an AI-native operating system for healthcare providers, including pharmacies, clinics, and hospitals. 

Our philosophy is simple: 

The best healthcare software might be the software healthcare professionals barely have to operate. 

The Opportunity

We're looking for an AI Engineering & Data Science Lead to own the technical direction, architecture, and execution of AI across Tapza's healthcare products. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. 

You'll work directly with the founding team, make consequential engineering decisions, build production-grade AI systems, and gradually develop the AI engineering team around you. 

We're looking for someone who has already taken AI systems beyond prototypes and successfully deployed them in real-world environments. 

What You'll Own

1. Agentic AI & LLM Engineering

- Architect, build, and deploy production-grade AI agents, RAG systems, and intelligent automation workflows. 
 - Develop reliable agent orchestration, tool integrations, structured data extraction, and enterprise system integrations. 
 - Implement robust guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, data security, observability, and failure recovery. 
 - Own model selection, evaluation, and optimization for accuracy, latency, reliability, scalability, and inference cost. 

2. Production AI Engineering

- Design scalable AI services, inference pipelines, and integrations with backend systems. 
 - Implement observability, automated testing, model monitoring, versioning, and rollback mechanisms. 
 - Optimize inference performance, reliability, and infrastructure costs. 
 - Establish secure data handling, access controls, and privacy-aware AI architecture. 

What We're Looking For

Required

- 5+ years of relevant software engineering, machine learning, or applied AI experience. 
 - Proven experience in architecting, building, and deploying AI/ML systems used in production. 
 - Strong Python programming and software engineering fundamentals. 
 - Experience with machine learning fundamentals, statistical evaluation, and model performance measurement. 
 - Experience building APIs, data pipelines, and cloud-deployed services. 
 - Practical understanding of model evaluation, latency optimization, inference economics, security, and production reliability. 
 - Ability to independently own complex technical problems from architecture through deployment. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers, reviewing technical designs, or leading technical delivery. 

Good to Have

- Experience with speech AI, multilingual NLP, OCR, or document intelligence. 
 - Experience with time-series forecasting and predictive analytics. 
 - Familiarity with AWS and production MLOps infrastructure. 
 - Experience with healthcare, healthtech, or other regulated industries. 
 - Experience building systems that process sensitive information. 
 - Familiarity with clinical workflows, interoperability standards, or ABDM. Healthcare domain experience is an advantage, not a requirement. Strong production engineering experience matters more. 

Why Join Tapza?

- Technical ownership: Shape the architecture and engineering direction of AI across multiple healthcare products. 
 - Real-world complexity: Solve problems involving reliability, multilingual environments, latency, inference costs, security, and imperfect data. 
 - Leadership opportunity: Help establish and grow Tapza's AI engineering function. 
 - Long-term upside: Equity participation and the potential to progress into a broader AI leadership role as the company grows. 

Compensation

Competitive compensation within our current startup-stage budget, along with meaningful equity participation. 

Detailed compensation and equity terms will be discussed during the hiring process. 

How to Apply

We're especially interested in understanding what you've actually built and shipped. 

Along with your resume or LinkedIn profile, please share: 

- One AI/ML system you personally architected or substantially built and deployed in production. 
 - Your specific technical contribution, the hardest engineering challenge, and how you solved it. 
 - The scale of the system and how you measured its reliability, accuracy, latency, or cost. GitHub repositories, technical write-ups, architecture diagrams, or project demonstrations are welcome where publicly shareable. 

We're looking for demonstrated engineering ownership-not just familiarity with AI tools and frameworks.

data.title: QA and compliance Specialist – QMS
data.company: Neo Power Electronics & Projects Private Limited
data.description:
Company Description: 

Established in 1975, Neo Power Electronics & Projects Private Limited is an ISO 9001: 2015, ISO 14001: 2015 and ISO 45001: 2018 certified leader in electrical manufacturing and EPC solutions, serving industrial, commercial, infrastructure and defence sectors across India, Southeast Asia and Africa. The company designs, manufactures, installs, tests and commissions high-performance electrical, electronics, instrumentation and automation systems and turnkey projects, and exports defence equipment including submarine and torpedo batteries. Neo Power delivers scalable, cost-effective solutions backed by precision execution and long-standing client relationships. 

Job Location: Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

Role Description: 

We manufacture electrical and electronic equipment, including products designed for hazardous-area (Ex) applications. We are looking for a  QA & Compliance Specialist  to support and maintain our  ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS), ISO 14001 Environmental Management System (EMS), and ISO 45001 Occupational Health & Safety (OH&S) Management System. The QA & Compliance Specialist will be responsible for supporting day-to-day quality activities on the shop floor, ensuring compliance with applicable quality, environmental, occupational health and safety, and hazardous-area (Ex) requirements. 

Roles and Responsibilities: 

- Maintain and update  QMS documentation, including procedures, work instructions, formats, controlled forms and quality records, ensuring revision control, traceability and withdrawal of obsolete documents; guide and train shop-floor personnel on the correct completion and maintenance of quality and production records. 
 - Conduct and coordinate  incoming, in-process and final inspections  of materials, components, assemblies and finished products against approved drawings, specifications and inspection plans, including review of inspection and test reports prior to product release/dispatch. 
 - Identify, segregate and control  non-conforming products; raise and track NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports) and coordinate root cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) with relevant departments through implementation, verification and closure. 
 - Monitor  process and product quality  on the shop floor, identify recurring defects and ensure identification and traceability of raw materials, components, work-in-progress and finished products, promoting a right-first-time culture with Production and Engineering. 
 - Maintain the  calibration schedule and records  for measuring, monitoring and test equipment, ensuring that only calibrated and valid instruments are used for inspection and testing. 
 - Support  supplier quality and customer complaint  investigations, including supplier-related NCRs and follow-up on corrective actions through timely closure. 
 - Support  internal, customer and certification audits  by preparing records and following up findings to closure; compile quality data and KPIs (rejection, rework, NCRs, complaints, CAPA status) for monthly quality reviews and management review inputs. 
 - Ensure that no unauthorised changes are made to  certified product designs, components, materials, software, processes or critical parameters without technical review, documented approval and change control, and maintain compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, customer and hazardous-area (Ex) certification requirements. 

Qualifications

- B. E. /B. Tech. in Electrical or Electronics Engineering from a recognised institution. 
 - 2-4 years in a QA/QC role in electrical or electronics manufacturing. 
 - Working knowledge of ISO 9001: 2015 QMS requirements, documentation and records; ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 knowledge is an advantage. 
 - Hands-on incoming, in-process and final inspection using measuring instruments and electrical test equipment. 
 - Proficient in MS Excel and Word, with good written and spoken English. 
 - Detail-oriented and disciplined in documentation, record control and closing quality actions. 

Preferred: 

- Experience in or an  IECEx, ATEX, or PESO-certified manufacturing organization, with awareness of applicable  IEC 60079 series  and  ISO/IEC 80079-34  requirements. 

- ISO 9001: 2015 Internal Auditor certification  or practical experience in conducting/supporting internal QMS audits. 

- Experience in  electrical/electronic manufacturing, preferably involving  electrical panels, lighting equipment, battery associated electronic control, or hazardous-area (Ex) equipment. 

- Familiarity with  Ex-product documentation, inspection requirements, traceability, change control, non-conformity management, and certification-related quality controls  will be an added advantage.

data.title: Lead Data Platform Engineer
data.description:
About the role

We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer to build and scale Arnor's data systems. You will lead the design and delivery of reliable data platforms across batch and migration pipelines, streaming and event-driven workloads, and analytics, lakehouse, and warehouse use cases. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set technical direction, work closely with product and platform teams, and manage a small team of engineers. Our platform is GCP-first, while some client deployments require other cloud environments. You will help us choose data technologies that fit the workload and deployment context rather than assume one processing or streaming tool for every use case. 

What you'll do

● Define and evolve the architecture and roadmap for Arnor's data systems, balancing scale, reliability, performance, security, and cost. 

● Design, build, and operate batch ingestion, transformation, migration, reconciliation, and historical backfill pipelines. 

● Develop event-driven and streaming data workflows with clear delivery guarantees, idempotency, retry and dead-letter handling, replay, and operational visibility. 

● Build analytics and warehouse/lakehouse capabilities, including robust data models and dependable access patterns for product and reporting needs. 

● Establish practical standards for data quality, provenance, freshness, coverage, lineage, and recoverability. Partner with product and platform teams on shared ownership of these capabilities. 

● Design pipelines to retain and trace source data where appropriate, surface partial results and processing failures, and support safe reprocessing without unnecessary source calls. 

● Build systems that respect tenant and project boundaries, access controls, and client deployment constraints. 

● Set service interfaces and data contracts with product, platform, and application

teams; keep downstream business logic and user-facing behavior with the owning

product teams. 

● Evaluate and evolve the data stack for GCP-first deployments and client

environments on other clouds. Use BigQuery where it fits; select processing and

streaming technologies based on workload and deployment requirements. 

● Lead, coach, and support a small engineering team through technical planning, 

design reviews, delivery, and ongoing development. 

● Stay hands-on through architecture work, code and data-model reviews, and

implementation of critical components. 

What you'll bring

● Strong experience designing and operating production data systems across batch

pipelines, migrations, event-driven workloads, and analytics. 

● Hands-on proficiency with SQL, Python, and Node. js. 

● Hands-on experience building or operating data workloads on Google Cloud

Platform (GCP). 

● At least one current Google Cloud certification relevant to cloud or data

engineering. 

● Experience with data modeling, pipeline reliability, data quality, and production

operations, including monitoring, failure recovery, backfills, and performance or cost

tuning. 

● Ability to design systems that are secure, maintainable, and suitable for multi-tenant

or customer-specific deployments. 

● Technical leadership experience, including guiding engineers, making architecture

decisions, and delivering through a team. 

● Clear communication and the ability to work across engineering, product, and

platform teams. 

● Willingness to work full-time onsite in Chandigarh. 

Preferred qualifications

● Experience with BigQuery and GCP data services. 

● Experience supporting data platforms deployed on AWS, Azure, or other

client-managed cloud environments. 

● Experience with PostgreSQL, high-volume data migrations, or multi-tenant

platforms. 

● Experience with warehouse or lakehouse architectures and large-scale data

processing. 

● Experience improving source-data coverage, provenance, data quality, and safe

reprocessing across multiple products. 

● Additional certifications in other cloud platforms, data engineering, or related

technologies. 

We are open to candidates from different industries and domains. Legal or court-data

experience is not required. 

Recommended experience

We recommend 8-12 years of relevant data or platform engineering experience, 

including at least 3 years in technical leadership or engineering team leadership. This

range should support the role's combination of hands-on system design, production

delivery, and people management while leaving room for strong candidates with different

career paths.

data.title: Head of AI Division – Enterprise AI, Generative AI & Agentic Platforms
data.description:
Role Overview

Our company is seeking an accomplished Head of AI Division to lead its enterprise-wide Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Intelligent Automation initiatives. This is a senior leadership position responsible for defining the AI vision, building and scaling AI capabilities, establishing enterprise AI platforms, and driving measurable business transformation across the organization's engineering, product, and operational ecosystems. 

The ideal candidate will bring 20+ years of experience across software engineering, enterprise architecture, technology leadership, and platform development, including substantial hands-on experience in designing and deploying production-grade AI and Generative AI solutions. 

The role requires a unique combination of executive leadership, deep technical expertise, product and business acumen, and the ability to transform emerging AI technologies into secure, scalable, and commercially valuable enterprise solutions. 

The Head of AI Division will work closely with executive leadership, Engineering, Product, Operations, Architecture, and Customer Success teams to establish AI as a strategic organizational capability, accelerate innovation, improve engineering productivity, and deliver sustainable business value. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise AI Strategy & Business Transformation

- Define and execute Solartis' enterprise AI strategy, vision, and multi-year transformation roadmap. 
 - Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation, and AI-powered decision systems across products and business functions. 
 - Translate business objectives into scalable AI initiatives with clearly defined outcomes, investment priorities, and measurable ROI. 
 - Establish enterprise AI reference architectures, technology standards, implementation frameworks, and reusable accelerators. 
 - Advise executive leadership on AI adoption, emerging technologies, investment priorities, opportunities, and associated risks. 
 - Drive an AI-first engineering and product development culture across the organization. 2. AI Division Leadership & Organizational Development

- Build, lead, and scale a high-performing AI division comprising AI architects, AI/ML engineers, Generative AI specialists, platform engineers, and research or innovation teams. 
 - Define the organizational structure, operating model, hiring strategy, capability development plans, and performance expectations for the AI division. 
 - Establish clear ownership and accountability across AI strategy, architecture, engineering, platform development, and production operations. 
 - Mentor senior technical leaders and develop a strong leadership pipeline within the AI organization. 
 - Foster collaboration across Engineering, Product, Security, Infrastructure, Operations, and business stakeholders. 
 - Manage resource allocation, delivery priorities, technology investments, and AI program budgets. 3. Enterprise Generative AI & Foundation Model Strategy

- Lead the evaluation, selection, architecture, and enterprise adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and open-source foundation models. 
 - Establish model selection, routing, orchestration, fine-tuning, inference optimization, and deployment strategies aligned with business requirements. 
 - Drive the adoption of platforms and technologies such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, and other relevant foundation models. 
 - Define strategies for balancing model performance, security, latency, scalability, licensing, and inference costs. 
 - Oversee the development of enterprise AI services, reusable frameworks, APIs, SDKs, and shared platform capabilities. 4. Enterprise RAG & Knowledge Intelligence Platforms

- Lead the architecture and implementation of enterprise-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platforms and knowledge intelligence systems. 
 - Establish scalable architectures integrating structured and unstructured enterprise data, semantic search, embeddings, vector databases, and knowledge graphs. 
 - Drive improvements in retrieval accuracy, contextual relevance, response quality, grounding, and hallucination mitigation. 
 - Oversee enterprise knowledge assistants, AI copilots, intelligent search solutions, and domain-specific AI applications. 
 - Establish standards for data access, source attribution, information security, and evaluation of knowledge-grounded AI systems. 5. Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation

- Define the enterprise roadmap for autonomous AI agents, multi-agent systems, and intelligent workflow orchestration. 
 - Lead the design and deployment of AI systems capable of planning, reasoning, tool use, task execution, and controlled decision support. 
 - Drive Agentic AI adoption across software engineering, testing, customer support, business operations, and relevant domain-specific workflows. 
 - Establish frameworks for agent orchestration, memory management, human-in-the-loop controls, exception handling, and safe execution. 
 - Define standards for agent observability, evaluation, access control, governance, and operational reliability. 
 - Ensure that autonomous workflows operate within clearly defined business rules, permissions, and accountability boundaries. 6. AI Platform Engineering & Production Delivery

- Own the architecture, engineering, deployment, and scaling of enterprise AI platforms in production environments. 
 - Establish engineering practices for MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps, including CI/CD, model lifecycle management, testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 
 - Drive the development of production-ready AI applications using robust APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native platforms. 
 - Establish end-to-end AI evaluation frameworks covering quality, accuracy, reliability, security, latency, scalability, and cost. 
 - Ensure AI solutions meet enterprise requirements for availability, resilience, performance, maintainability, and operational support. 
 - Maintain strong technical oversight of critical architecture decisions, engineering standards, and production implementations. 7. AI-Powered Engineering Transformation

- Lead enterprise-wide adoption of AI-assisted software development and intelligent engineering workflows. 
 - Drive AI-enabled code generation, code review, automated testing, documentation, developer assistance, and DevOps automation. 
 - Partner with engineering leadership to identify productivity bottlenecks and establish measurable improvements in software delivery. 
 - Develop frameworks to assess AI-assisted engineering quality, developer productivity, defect reduction, and delivery efficiency. 
 - Promote responsible adoption of AI development tools while maintaining software quality, intellectual property protection, and security standards. 8. AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI

- Establish enterprise AI governance frameworks covering responsible AI, privacy, security, risk management, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Define policies for model access, data protection, prompt injection mitigation, sensitive information handling, and AI application security. 
 - Ensure appropriate human oversight, auditability, explainability, and traceability for AI-assisted and agent-driven decisions. 
 - Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, and Architecture teams to establish risk-based controls for enterprise AI adoption. 
 - Implement governance mechanisms for model evaluation, production approval, change management, incident response, and continuous monitoring. 9. Technology Innovation & Strategic Partnerships

- Lead AI innovation programs, technology incubation, proofs of concept, and enterprise-scale pilots. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, foundation models, orchestration technologies, and industry developments. 
 - Establish strategic technology partnerships and guide build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Convert promising AI experiments into scalable production capabilities with clear adoption and business-value criteria. 
 - Represent the organization in strategic technology discussions and provide thought leadership to executive management. 10. Portfolio, Budget & Business Outcome Management

- Own the AI division's delivery portfolio, investment priorities, resource utilization, and operational performance. 
 - Establish governance for AI project prioritization, delivery milestones, dependencies, and risk management. 
 - Define measurable business cases for AI initiatives and track their impact on productivity, operating costs, quality, customer experience, and revenue opportunities. 
 - Communicate portfolio performance, investment requirements, delivery risks, and realized business value to executive stakeholders. 
 - Ensure that AI investments deliver sustainable outcomes rather than isolated proofs of concept. Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 20+ years of overall experience in software engineering, technology architecture, enterprise platforms, and technology leadership. 
 - Significant experience leading large engineering, architecture, AI/ML, or platform engineering organizations. 
 - Strong hands-on technical foundation in AI/ML and Generative AI, with demonstrable experience designing and deploying enterprise AI solutions in production. 
 - Proven track record of defining technology strategy and translating it into successful enterprise-scale implementation. 
 - Experience building and scaling technical teams, leading senior architects and engineering managers, and managing complex technology portfolios. 
 - Demonstrated ability to engage with executive stakeholders and align AI investments with business priorities. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, application security, and production engineering. Mandatory Technical Expertise

Candidates must demonstrate substantial expertise across the core areas below. Equivalent technologies are acceptable where the candidate has strong architecture and implementation experience. 

Generative AI & Foundation Models

- Experience in Insurance, InsurTech, Financial Services, Healthcare, or enterprise SaaS environments.

 - Advanced flow cytometry expertise, including titration, multicolour panel design, compensation and instrument QC. 
 - Experience in commercial reagent manufacturing, lot release and specification-based quality control. 
 - Working knowledge of GMP principles and/or ISO 13485 quality systems. 

Desirable Experience

- Background with a global reagent manufacturer, CDMO or biopharma quality-control laboratory.

data.title: Senior Production Engineer
data.description:
About DataNimbus

DataNimbus is an enterprise AI company with deep vertical solutions in financial services

and industrial sectors. We build domain-native AI that understands how industries actually

operate - not just how data flows through them. Our solutions are outcome-driven and

industry-specific, delivering measurable results across how money moves, how assets

perform, and how businesses grow. We go deep so our customers don't have to start from

scratch. 

Domain depth. Enterprise scale. AI outcomes. 

About the Role

When a bank's payment doesn't move, someone has to find out why - in code they didn't

write, on servers they can't log into, with the bank on the line. We're hiring two people who

want to be that someone. 

Our payments platform moves money for large banks: microservices in Node. js, Go, Java

and Angular on MongoDB, NATS and Redis, running on Kubernetes. 

When a payment doesn't move, a fee doesn't post or a screen goes blank, you find out why

from the code, the data and the logs. Then you fix it so it can't happen again. 

What You'll Do

● Every production issue, end to end: from the bank's ticket to the fix running in their

release. 

● Hunt root causes. Triage bank tickets, reproduce the failure, find the cause in code, 

data and logs. When it's infra, network or a third party, prove it with evidence. 

● Read the data like a detective. Read-only MongoDB queries that show exactly what

happened. Audit live data (schedules, holidays, duplicates) before it hurts, and

reconcile it safely. 

● Make it fast. Slow screens, long-running queries, connection-pool leaks, end-of-day

CPU spikes, pod evictions: take each to a cause, then fix the query, the index or the

resource limit. 

● Ship the fix. Backport it across many live release lines, knowing its blast radius

before it goes out. 

● Pass the bank's scrutiny. Triage vulnerability-scan findings and answer audit

questionnaires. 

● Be the voice the bank trusts. Customer replies, RCAs, audit responses, weekly status

reports, leadership briefings. 

● Write it all down. Runbooks, RCAs, decisions and the things only you know go into

shared docs the whole team can find. 

● Build your own tools. scripts, agents and knowledge bases that make the next

investigation faster than the last. 

What We're Looking For

● 5+ years owning production for distributed systems, as an SRE, production or

backend engineer. 

● Fearless with code you didn't write. Node. js and Go fluently, Java well enough. You

can trace an issue from an Angular screen down to the database. 

● MongoDB in depth. Aggregation pipelines, $lookup, indexes, explain(), slow-query

logs and schema drift. Safe, read-only queries on production data. 

● Distributed-systems instincts. Event-driven flows (NATS), Redis, schedulers, 

workflow engines, webhooks, retries, idempotency and race conditions. 

● Containers. Docker, Kubernetes (limits, evictions, OOMKilled), Jenkins and AWS. 

Comfortable diagnosing systems you can only see through logs you asked for. 

● Excellent written and verbal communication. Short, accurate RCAs and replies that

bank engineers and executives act on. Calm and clear on an incident call, and able to

explain a failure to an executive in two minutes. 

● A documenting habit. You leave runbooks, decision records and how-tos behind you, 

so nobody has to ask you twice. 

● You have looked at how your team works, found a better way and made it stick -

and you can tell us what changed. 

● AI-native. Python, Node. js and mongosh for audits, safe data fixes and tooling. Daily

use of AI coding agents (we use Claude Code). 

Why Join DataNimbus?

At DataNimbus, we believe in shaping a sustainable, AI-driven future while offering an

environment that prioritises learning, innovation, and growth. Our core values -

Customer-Centricity, Simplicity, Curiosity, Responsibility, and Adaptability - are the

foundation of our workplace, ensuring every team member can make a meaningful impact. 

Joining DataNimbus means: 

● Working with cutting-edge technologies at the intersection of Data and AI. 

● Contributing to solutions trusted by global financial institutions for their scalability, 

security, and efficiency. 

● Growing in a culture that rewards technical depth, ownership, and continuous learning. 

If you're a technical leader who's energised by delivery, not just direction - DataNimbus is the

place for you.

data.title: Senior Staff Engineer
data.description:
Spreetail propels brands to increase their ecommerce market share across the globe while improving their operational costs. Learn how we are building one of the fastest-growing ecommerce companies in history: www. spreetail. com . 

Spreetail is becoming a third-party logistics provider, taking on warehousing and fulfillment for external merchants and brands. The 3PL Staff Engineer owns the technical foundation of this new product: the multi-tenant systems that manage client onboarding, inventory, warehouse operations, order fulfillment, and billing for outside customers using Spreetail's fulfillment network. 

You will operate as a founding technical leader for a 0-to-1 platform, bringing deep ecommerce domain expertise to bear on warehouse operations, inventory management, and order fulfillment at multi-tenant scale. This platform is being built AI-native from the start - with demand forecasting, automated exception handling, and anomaly detection woven into core workflows rather than bolted on afterward. Your work directly determines whether Spreetail can reliably sell 3PL services to external clients - making it a direct driver of new revenue and margin. 

This is a hands-on, high-ownership, build-from-the-ground-up role requiring strong distributed systems expertise, deep familiarity with ecommerce order-to-fulfillment flows, and the ability to make foundational architecture decisions for a new business line. 

Why Spreetail

Join a high-performing technology organization that values innovation, ownership, and collaboration. You'll work with talented engineers who care deeply about building scalable systems and driving real business impact. Together, we'll make Spreetail better. 

How You Will Achieve Success

A scalable, multi-tenant 3PL platform capable of onboarding external clients with distinct catalogs, inventory, and fulfillment rules

Reliable core systems for inventory management, order routing, and warehouse operations across client accounts

Fast, low-friction onboarding for new 3PL clients through configurable, reusable platform components

Accurate, real-time inventory and order visibility for both internal ops teams and external clients

Reliable, observable, self-healing fulfillment pipelines with clear SLAs clients can be sold against

Reduced manual intervention in exception handling (mis-ships, short-ships, returns, billing disputes) through AI-driven automation

Clear architectural direction as the 3PL platform scales from first clients to broad external adaptation. 

What Experiences Will Help You In This Role

- 6-8+ years of experience building and shipping production backend systems
 - Experience informally or formally leading the technical direction of a team or workstream (design reviews, mentorship, setting standards)
 - Experience with ecommerce order management, inventory, warehouse, or logistics systems is a strong plus
 - Comfortable working in a fast-moving, still-being-defined 0-to-1 environment

Technical Skills

- Strong fundamentals in backend engineering: APIs, data modeling, databases, and distributed systems
 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and cloud-native service design
 - Familiarity with event-driven architectures (queues, streams, async processing)
 - Strong testing, debugging, and production-support practices

Technical Leadership

- Ability to set technical direction and make sound judgment calls without direct authority
 - Strong code review and mentorship instincts
 - Comfort representing a workstream in broader architecture discussions

Domain & AI Exposure (Nice to Have)

- Exposure to EDI standards or 3PL/WMS integration patterns
 - Experience integrating ML model outputs (forecasts, predictions, anomaly scores) into application logic
 - Interest in growing domain expertise in e-commerce logistics and fulfillment

Collaboration & Communication

- Ability to influence and align engineers without formal authority over them
 - Clear written and verbal communication, especially in async, distributed team settings
 - Comfort balancing hands-on technical work with guiding others

₹0 - ₹0 a year

This is a remote position and requires candidates to have an available work-from-home setup

Desktop/Laptop System Requirements

- 4th generation or higher, at least Intel i3 or equivalent processor; 
 - at least 4GB RAM; 
 - Windows 10 and above or MAC OSX operating system
 - You are required to provide your own dual monitors

A strong and stable internet connection (A DSL, cable or fiber wired internet service with 10 Mbps plan or higher for primary connection)

PC Headset

A high-definition (HD) external or integrated webcam with at least 720p resolution. 

Please be aware of scammers. Spreetail will only contact you through Lever or the spreetail. com domain. Spreetail will never ask candidates for money during the recruitment process. Please reach out to [email protected] directly if you have any concerns. Emails from @spreetailjobs. com are fraudulent.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Your Contribution

 - Align with Foundry shop team & to improve the Casting product quality. 
 - Scrap Reduction & Quality Improvement

 - Improves tool life through innovative solutions. 
 - Reduces tool changeover time and inventory. 
 - Layout Improvement & Material Handling Optimization

 - Ensure ergonomic workstations. 
 - Identify and implement process improvements to increase production efficiency, reduce scrap rates, minimize waste, and lower costs, optimize the head counts. . 
 - Work closely with cross-functional teams, including quality control, production, maintenance, and R&D, to ensure smooth production flow and the successful integration of new technologies. 
 - Contribution for New product development & PPAP document preparation.

 - Minimum 10 -15 years' experience in Machining shop for Casting and Forged components. 
 - Prefer the knowledge and experience of automotive components, like Camshaft, Crankshaft etc. . 
 - Preference will be given for expertise in CBN Grinding, Turning operation & induction hardening. 
 - Knowledge of IATF 16949, GD&T, drawings

data.title: Senior System Performance Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI - the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a "learning machine" that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can tackle, and that matter to the world. This is our life's work to amplify human imagination and intelligence. Make the choice to join us today!

As part of the Silicon Solutions Team, we architect and deliver groundbreaking solutions for productizing NVIDIA's chips into consumer, professional, server, mobile, and automotive markets. Silicon characterization, correlation to arch & design expectations, finalize product specifications, develop productization techniques and infrastructure around it are part of our responsibilities. Dealing with challenges of the latest process node technologies is also part of the work. Join this dynamic team as a Senior System Perf Engineer, and help craft the future of computing in Bengaluru. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead the productization of Performance controllers from pre-silicon planning through bring-up, tuning, validation, and production. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, design, firmware, and software teams to define controller requirements & features , identify improvements and translate new capabilities into production-ready solutions. 
 - Characterize and tune controller behaviour across workloads, operating conditions, silicon variation, and product power and thermal limits. Maximize the perf and Perf/Watt with-in architectural bottlenecks & limitations, Power/Thermal system limits to provide best customer experience for the products
 - Correlate silicon behaviour with pre-silicon expectations, debug & resolve complex problems during bring up and final closed loop performance stage involving silicon HW, firmware, software, power delivery network, system thermals etc. 
 - Apply AI/ML and data-driven methods to analyze silicon characterization and HW telemetry data, identify anomalies and trends, accelerate controller tuning and improve debug as well as silicon validation execution efficiency. 

What We Need To See

- B. Tech or M. Tech in Electronics Engineering stream. 
 - At least 5+ years of proven experience in silicon validation, system level design, and power/performance optimization. 
 - Strong understanding of aspects related to silicon power and performance, technology node impacts, Hardware and Software interactions at system level. 
 - Hands-on experience with silicon bring up, validation and productization
 - Good HW architectural understanding and orientation
 - Very good problem solving and hardware debugging skills. 
 - Strong good data analysis and logical reasoning skills. 
 - Strong familiarity with HW lab environment. 
 - Must be a great teammate and ready to collaborate with global teams from diverse cultural backgrounds in a high energy environment. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Extensive background in DVFS, voltage/frequency management, HW telemetries, Performance throttling, silicon protection mechanisms on advanced ASIC/SoC products. 
 - Contributions that improved controller behaviour, silicon performance, power efficiency, thermal management, bring-up/productization methodologies. 
 - Experience connecting controller behaviour across simulation, silicon, firmware, and system-level measurements and converting findings into production tuning. 
 - Experience applying AI/ML to engineering workflows, such as controller tuning, characterization analytics, anomaly detection, or debug assistants deployed beyond personal use. 

With every new architecture and process node, balancing performance against power and thermal limits becomes tougher. Our controllers are at the forefront of this issue: drawing out the performance the silicon was crafted to achieve while shielding it when workloads push its limits. If you like understanding dynamic silicon behaviour, addressing hardware-software challenges, and influencing NVIDIA products at scale, we'd love to connect!

data.title: Associate, AI Model Validation, RQA
data.description:
About This Role

Business Overview

The Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA) group provides independent oversight of BlackRock's fiduciary and enterprise risks. RQA's principal objectives are to advance the firm's risk management practices and to deliver independent risk expertise and constructive challenge to drive better business and investment outcomes. 

RQA is committed to investing in our people to increase individual enablement and ultimately build a stronger team. Our goal is to create a culture of inclusion which encourages collaboration, innovation, diversity and the development our future leaders. We actively engage in discussions on career growth and work with team members to understand how personal passions and strength connect with our purpose. 

Role Description

The Enterprise Risk team within RQA oversees those risks which directly impact the corporate entity (i. e. BlackRock, Inc. , or one of its subsidiaries), rather than the fiduciary risks assumed by funds/clients, such as investment risks and counterparty risks. The team's focus includes but is not limited to operational risk, technology, vendor, model and market risk, stress testing for market risk and the quantitative estimation of capital adequacy requirements. 

The AI Validation Associate will perform independent reviews of AI tools and agents used across BlackRock, including agentic systems, RAG applications and other business workflows. This role requires strong technical expertise combined with risk management skills to challenge system design, data integrity, and performance monitoring. The role will be based onsite in our GGN office. 

Key Responsibilities

- Conduct independent validation of AI usage in workflows, including testing for accuracy, efficiency of guardrails, orchestration, memory management and token usage. 
 - Design and implement comprehensive validation strategies and test plans tailored to each AI use case. Define clear success criteria and quality benchmarks to measure whether the AI solution meets all requirements and standards. 
 - Understand tool architecture, potential vulnerabilities and weaknesses. 
 - Assess conceptual soundness, methodology, and alignment with intended business use. 
 - Review data quality, preprocessing steps and engineering decisions for AI use cases. 
 - Execute functional and performance tests. 
 - Evaluate performance metrics, robustness, and limitations under various scenarios. 
 - Document validation findings, provide recommendations 
 - Stay current on emerging AI technologies, validation techniques, and regulatory developments. 
 - Communicate validation conclusions to relevant stakeholders, including escalating identified findings, risks or gaps to senior leadership and approval committees 
 - Collaborate with AI Engineering, Data Science, and Risk teams to enhance AI transparency and trustworthiness. 

Experience, Skills And Qualification

- With 3-7 years' works experience in the IT or financial industry. 
 - Degree or Advanced degree (MS, PhD) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related field. 
 - Strong understanding of generative AI technologies, including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic systems, prompt engineering, tool use, and modern AI application architectures. 
 - Experience with Python and common AI development libraries and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow or similar). 
 - Excellent analytical, communication, and documentation skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and challenge stakeholders constructively. 
 - Experience with one or more of the following: 
 - Validating usage of large language models (LLMs) in business context
 - Evaluation methodologies, benchmark development, ground-truth creation, and AI quality assessment
 - AI observability, monitoring, performance measurement, and operational controls
 - AI orchestration frameworks, agent architectures, prompt engineering, memory management, and context optimization
 - Exposure to cloud-based AI platforms and scalable model deployment 
 - MCP, APIs, connectors and integrations of AI solutions with enterprise systems and data sources
 - Responsible AI practices, including fairness, explainability, bias assessment, transparency, and model governance
 - Fine-tuning or model customization techniques
 - Security testing and risk assessment of AI systems, including prompt injection, jailbreak, and data leakage testing

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. 

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock's hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person - aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. 

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work - enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we've provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. 

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children's educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. 

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment - the one we make in our employees. It's why we're dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. 

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers. BlackRock. com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. 

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.
